products.name: Whole House Water Filtration System (Whole-House Water Filter)
products.description:
SEONDO’s Whole-House Water Filtration System filters the incoming tap water to provide cleaner water throughout the entire home.

In the first stage, a 5-micron sediment filter removes rust, sand and other suspended particles. The second cartridge combines the functions of the second and third filtration stages: its carbon block reduces residual chlorine and unpleasant odors, while the integrated scale inhibitor helps prevent scale buildup. By combining the carbon block and scale inhibitor in a single cartridge, the system effectively helps protect pipes, faucets and household appliances from scale deposits.

Its compact and lightweight design makes it ideal for apartments and houses with limited installation space. The system features a robust, durable SUS304L housing and a user-friendly cartridge design that allows filters to be replaced easily by hand without any special tools.

Its modular design also allows additional filter modules to be connected according to the required flow rate, providing flexibility for various installation environments and water usage requirements. Another key competitive advantage is its reasonable price compared with other whole-house filtration systems offering a similar level of performance.

products.name: Commercial Water Filtration System (Commercial Water Filter)
products.description:
SEONDO’s commercial water filtration system is designed for use in a wide range of commercial environments, including restaurants, cafés and convenience stores. It supplies cleaner water to ice machines, coffee machines and beverage equipment while helping reduce performance issues and maintenance requirements caused by water quality.

The carbon filter reduces residual chlorine and unpleasant tastes and odors, helping preserve the original taste of beverages and food. In addition, the carbon block and scale-inhibition media are integrated into a single cartridge to help prevent scale buildup caused by calcium and magnesium, effectively protecting essential commercial equipment such as ice machines and coffee machines.

The system can be installed without a separate water softener or complex equipment, and its filter is easy to replace and maintain. By providing both water filtration and scale protection in a single cartridge, it also helps reduce installation space and maintenance costs.

products.name: NMN BIOME SERUM
products.description:
The key strength of the NMN BIOME SERUM is that it is not simply formulated by combining popular active ingredients; instead, microbial co-culture technology itself is designed as a core product differentiator.

Four different lactic acid bacteria strains with distinct characteristics are co-cultured and then processed using a low-temperature ultrasonic lysis method. This approach is designed to utilize not only bacterial cell-derived components, but also various metabolites and bioactive substances generated during the co-culture process. The formula is further combined with NMN, targeting multiple skin concerns including skin aging, hydration, and barrier care within a single product.

Another major strength is that the product does not rely solely on the theoretical benefits of its ingredients. The finished formulation has undergone human application testing related to skin hydration, transepidermal water loss (TEWL), wrinkles, and skin irritation, enabling the product to build objective performance data. This allows us to move beyond simply claiming that the product contains “good ingredients” and instead focus on validating the actual value and functionality of the finished product.

The technology is also designed to extend beyond a single serum. Based on the current four-strain co-culture platform, we are planning to develop a five-strain co-cultured lactic acid bacteria lysate material by incorporating a functional microbial strain covered by a patent acquired from Jeonbuk National University. In the future, this platform can be expanded into microbiome-based skincare products targeting specific concerns such as soothing, brightening, skin barrier care, and anti-aging.

In short, the NMN BIOME SERUM is a bio-skincare product differentiated not simply by “what ingredients are included,” but by “which strains are selected, how they are co-cultured and lysed, and how the resulting mechanism is designed for the skin.”

products.name: KONGPAM (Vegan ham)
products.description:
JANUSOY products are made primarily from soy protein and methylcellulose.

They are among the most advanced meat alternatives, designed to faithfully recreate the texture and flavor of conventional processed meat.

When heated above 60°C (140°F), the structure of KONGPAM becomes firmer and more cohesive, while retaining a pleasant juiciness and savory richness within. With every bite, you can experience the texture and juiciness traditionally associated with processed meat products.

Because KONGPAM maintains its flavor and shape without significant changes during cooking, it can be used in a wide variety of dishes, including salads, musubi, pasta, budae-jjigae, dumplings, and jjajangmyeon.

As a plant-based luncheon meat that closely resembles the luncheon meat we are familiar with, KONGPAM has already been successfully introduced through a pop-up store in Hawaii. We are also currently in discussions to supply KONGPAM to Iyasume Musubi, a well-known musubi franchise in Hawaii.

In addition to KONGPAM, we are preparing KONG NUGGETS, a plant-based alternative to chicken nuggets, and KONG STICKS, a plant-based alternative to meat sticks. We are also developing products that combine our plant-based meat with tteok, Korea’s traditional rice cake.

products.name: Doraji Candy (Bellflower Root Candy)
products.description: Baragi Doraji Candy (Bellflower Root Candy) is a traditional Korean herbal candy developed by a husband-and-wife team of licensed herbalists, both graduates of Kyung Hee University. Half of the candy's 4% pure active ingredient content is a patented, deeply steeped bellflower root (Platycodon grandiflorus) concentrate, reduced to a rich 65 Brix. This concentrate delivers 4.12±0.31 mg/g of Platycodin D — roughly four times the level specified in the Chinese Pharmacopoeia (ChP) reference standard. It is rounded out with schisandra, quince, pear and licorice concentrates plus a hint of lemon and menthol for a clean, refreshing finish. Made with cane sugar and Korean rice syrup instead of refined white sugar, it delivers a deep, gentle sweetness with zero refined sugar. Each piece is individually wrapped for hygienic, on-the-go enjoyment — a favorite among people who talk for a living, long-distance drivers, and anyone who loves a crisp, refreshing taste, making it a thoughtful, easy-to-share wellness gift.

products.name: Ssanghwa Candy
products.description: Baragi Ssanghwa Candy captures the deep, warming flavor of traditional Korean Ssanghwa-tang (a classic herbal tonic tea) in a single piece of candy. Nine time-honored herbal ingredients — peony root, steamed rehmannia root, astragalus root, cnidium rhizome, angelica root, ginger, jujube, cinnamon and licorice — are carefully concentrated into a rich, thick 65 Brix Ssanghwa extract, which makes up the majority of the candy's 4% pure active ingredient content. Made with cane sugar and Korean rice syrup rather than refined white sugar, it delivers deep, natural sweetness with zero refined sugar. It can be enjoyed simply by letting it slowly dissolve in the mouth, or dissolved in hot water to recreate a fragrant cup of Ssanghwa tea — giving it two ways to enjoy in one product. It is especially loved by those who enjoy warm tea and rich, traditional herbal flavors, and makes a thoughtful gift for parents and elders.

products.name: Mugwort Candy
products.description: Baragi Mugwort Candy is a wellness candy that makes mugwort (ssuk) — an ingredient long cherished in everyday Korean life — easy and enjoyable to consume. Baragi focused on flavonoids, the key active compounds in mugwort, and researched its own proprietary ingredient ratio. The mugwort extract is processed using spray-drying technology, which atomizes the liquid extract into fine droplets and dries them rapidly with hot air, minimizing nutrient loss and preserving the ingredient's natural flavor. A subtle mugwort aroma and a touch of menthol round out the candy's fragrant, refreshing profile. Made with cane sugar and Korean rice syrup instead of refined white sugar, it offers deep, gentle sweetness with zero refined sugar, and each piece is individually wrapped for hygienic, on-the-go enjoyment. It's especially recommended for those who love mugwort's fragrant flavor, enjoy warm tea, or are looking for a distinctive wellness candy, and makes an easy, thoughtful gift for parents.

products.name: The Baragi Healthy Candy Gift Set (3 Flavors)
products.description: The Baragi Healthy Candy Gift Set (3 Flavors) brings together Doraji (Bellflower Root) Candy, Mugwort Candy and Ssanghwa Candy in a single traditional Korean herbal candy gift box. The line has been researched since 2019 by a husband-and-wife team of licensed herbalists, both graduates of Kyung Hee University, under an ongoing industry-academic cooperation agreement with the university that pairs time-honored herbal know-how with modern manufacturing technology. Each flavor is built around its own signature ingredient: Doraji Candy features a patented, deeply steeped bellflower root concentrate; Ssanghwa Candy is built on a rich 65 Brix concentrate of nine traditional herbal ingredients including peony root, steamed rehmannia root and astragalus root; and Mugwort Candy uses a spray-dried mugwort extract that preserves the ingredient's natural nutrients and flavor. All three are sweetened with cane sugar and Korean rice syrup instead of refined white sugar, for a deep, gentle sweetness with zero refined sugar, and each piece is individually wrapped for hygienic, easy sharing. The set contains three 405g tubes (1,215g total) presented in an elegant cylindrical gift case with a complimentary shopping bag, plus an optional traditional bojagi wrapping service for an extra personal touch. products.name: K StylEat Food Kimchi Pancake Kit 376g
products.description: Kimchi Pancake Kit is a DIY K-Food Kit designed to make it easy for consumers to prepare and enjoy authentic Korean kimchi pancakes at home. With no need for complicated ingredient preparation or advanced cooking skills, even consumers who are new to Korean cuisine can easily experience making a popular Korean dish themselves. Made with kimchi and dried vegetables, the kit delivers the distinctive flavor of kimchi and the crispy yet tender texture of traditional Korean pancakes. More than just a convenient meal solution, it offers an interactive K-Food experience that allows consumers to cook, discover, and enjoy Korean cuisine at home. The product is also Indonesia HALAL certified, making it suitable for a wider range of global markets.

products.name: K stylEat Food Korean Fried Chicken Batter Mix
products.description: Korean Fried Chicken Batter Mix is specially formulated to help consumers easily recreate the signature crispy and crunchy texture of authentic Korean-style fried chicken. Its carefully developed formulation creates a light, crispy coating with long-lasting crunch even after cooling, helping maintain excellent texture and quality from preparation to serving. Available in both Original and Spicy flavors, the product offers versatile options to suit different consumer preferences and menu concepts. With simple preparation and consistent results, it is suitable not only for fried chicken but also for wings, tenders, nuggets, and a variety of other fried foods. Designed for both home cooking and professional foodservice applications, this convenient batter mix makes it easy to deliver a consistent Korean fried chicken experience without complicated preparation.

products.name: K stylEat Food Korean Crispy Seaweed Furikake
products.description: Korean Crispy Seaweed Furikake is a Korean-style seaweed topping made with quality Korean seaweed, enhanced with the nutty flavors of sesame seeds and sesame oil. Its light and crispy texture adds a delicious savory taste and satisfying crunch with just a simple sprinkle. Beyond steamed rice, it can be enjoyed as a versatile topping or seasoning for rice balls, bibimbap, noodles, salads, poke bowls, egg dishes, and a variety of fusion meals. As a ready-to-eat product, it requires no additional preparation, making it an easy and convenient way to add authentic Korean seaweed flavor to everyday meals. The resealable stand-up pouch also provides convenient storage and helps maintain freshness after opening. With its familiar yet distinctive Korean flavor, the product is well suited not only for existing furikake consumers but also for global consumers looking to discover K-Food and versatile Asian-style toppings.

products.name: K StylEat Food CUP UDON
products.description: Cup Udons are convenient Korean-style cup noodles available in four flavors: Shoyu, Kimchi, Spicy, and Chicken. Unlike conventional oil-fried instant ramen, the product uses boiled udon noodles, offering a healthier option with a pleasantly chewy noodle texture. Each cup provides a quick and easy meal without the need for complicated preparation or additional cooking equipment. The Shoyu, Kimchi, and Spicy varieties come in 192g cups, while the Chicken variety comes in a 173g cup. Designed for ambient storage and easy handling, the product combines convenience with a simple and trendy package, making it suitable for enjoying Korean-style noodles at home or on the go.

products.name: K stylEat Food CUP TTEOKBOKKI
products.description:
Cup Tteokbokki is a convenient ready-to-eat product that brings one of Korea’s most iconic street foods, Tteokbokki, into an easy-to-prepare cup format. Available in four flavors—Mild, Spicy, Carbo, and Jjajang—it offers a variety of choices to suit different consumer preferences while delivering the signature chewy texture of Korean rice cakes.

Each 178g cup contains rice cakes, flakes, and powdered sauce, allowing consumers to easily prepare and enjoy Tteokbokki using a microwave without complicated cooking or additional ingredients. The product is also made without animal-derived ingredients and can be stored at ambient temperature, making it convenient for storage, distribution, and everyday consumption.

Combining the authentic taste and experience of Korean street food in a convenient single-serve cup, Cup Tteokbokki offers an accessible way for both K-Food enthusiasts and consumers new to Korean cuisine to discover and enjoy one of Korea’s most popular dishes.

products.name: K StylEat Food Crispy baked fish seaweed snacks

Instead of being oil-fried, the snacks are oven-baked to create a light and crispy texture while providing a high-protein snacking option. Made with processed fish meat, seaweed, snack sauce, seasoning, and sunflower oil, each bag contains approximately 4–5g of protein. The product is offered in multiple formats, including 15g, 25g, and 200g packs, to suit different consumption needs. Combining the savory taste of fish with the crisp texture of seaweed, it provides a distinctive alternative to conventional seaweed snacks and can be conveniently enjoyed as an everyday snack or a light accompaniment to drinks.

The product is compatible with Keto, Vegan, Vegetarian, Gluten-Free, and Low-Carb diets, making it suitable for a wide range of consumers. Each shelf-ready package contains 20 individual 4g packs, allowing for convenient display, storage, and on-the-go consumption. By eliminating the plastic tray and using seaweed cultivated and harvested in South Korea, the product combines convenience, sustainability, and the distinctive taste of Korean seaweed in a simple snack format.

products.name: Korean Pear Concentrate
products.description:
The distinctively mild, smooth taste of Pyrus pyrifolia (Asian pear) is characterized by its exceptionally low acidity, sorbitol-rich sugar profile, and subtle, non-overpowering natural aroma.

Clean, Subtle Sweetness from Distinct Sugar Profile

Clean Sorbitol Refreshment: Unlike sucrose, which leaves a heavy, lingering stickiness on the palate, natural sorbitol delivers a crisp, cooling sweetness with a clean, light finish.

Rapid Fructose Release: Fructose provides an immediate burst of gentle sweetness without a cloying aftertaste, maintaining a balanced weight in product formulations.

Ultra-Low Acidity Free from Acid Bite

Low Malic Acid & Mild pH: Far lower in organic acids (<1.0% titratable acidity) with a milder pH (4.0–4.6) compared to apples, citrus, or European pears, eliminating sharp sourness and throat bite.

Minimal Astringency: Negligible levels of tannins and polyphenols prevent dry, puckering astringency, resulting in a remarkably silky-smooth mouthfeel and clean swallow.

Rounding Effect on Harsh Flavors in Formulations

Masking Bitter & Pungent Functional Botanicals: Softens the harsh, sharp edges of functional ingredients—such as the acridity of balloon flower root (saponin), the bitterness of red ginseng, and the pungent heat of ginger—significantly improving consumer acceptance.

Harmonizing Salinity and Acidity in Sauces: Mellows the harsh saltiness of soy sauce and the sharp bite of vinegar in marinades (e.g., Korean BBQ/Bulgogi) and savory dressings, imparting a rounded, natural umami balance.

Sensory Differentiation from European Pear (Pyrus communis)

European Pear (Pyrus communis): Develops a dense, buttery texture upon post-harvest ripening, accompanied by heavy musky notes and distinct acidity.

Asian Pear (Pyrus pyrifolia): Delivers a crisp, watery, clean flavor profile without heavy aromatics, serving as an ideal neutral blending base that supports other hero ingredients without overpowering them.

products.name: BOKBUNJA CONCENTRATE(BRIX:50)
products.description:
Rich Flavor & Complex Balance: Concentrated to 50°Bx, it harmonizes the rich sweetness of fructose and glucose with organic acids (citric and malic acids / 2.5–4.5% acidity) to deliver a deep, well-rounded sweet-and-tart flavor.
High-Potency Natural Anthocyanin: Rich in cyanidin-glycoside natural pigments, it imparts an upscale, vibrant red-to-purple hue without the need for synthetic colorants.
Polyphenol-Driven Rich Body: Peel-derived tannins and polyphenols provide subtle astringency, delivering a full, satisfying mouthfeel and lingering aftertaste that prevents dilution flatness in blended formulations.

Natural Colorant Alternative (Clean Label): Replaces synthetic tar colorants and carmine, allowing a clean-label declaration of "Black Raspberry Juice Concentrate" while achieving appealing, naturally derived red and purple shades.
Powerful Off-Flavor Masking: Robust berry aromatics and vibrant acidity effectively mask the fishy, bitter, or acrid off-notes of active ingredients like arginine, collagen, red ginseng, and deer antler velvet.
Strong Health-Oriented Market Appeal: Capitalizes on its reputation as a traditional botanical (Rubus coreanus) and its high antioxidant capacity, driving strong marketing synergy for vitality, anti-fatigue, and men's wellness formulations.

Pigment Degradation & pH Sensitivity: Because anthocyanins readily degrade, brown, or turn dull under high heat and alkaline conditions, HTST (low-temperature, short-time) pasteurization and an acidic formulation window (pH 3.0–4.0) are recommended.
Oxidation Prevention & Cold Storage: Light-shielded packaging and frozen storage (-18°C or below) are essential to minimize non-enzymatic browning and flavor deterioration in concentrated form.

Health & Functional Formulations: Black raspberry juice pouches, arginine/collagen stick jellies, energy drinks
Alcoholic & Beverage Bases: Traditional black raspberry wines, liqueurs, highball base syrups, non-alcoholic cocktail mixers

products.name: Cool and Hot Water Mat(Mat)

- Safe Peltier Semiconductor Technology
By utilizing semiconductor thermoelectric elements, this product eliminates the conventional method of boiling water over 90°C with wire coils, completely removing the risk of burns. This perfectly aligns with global energy-saving trends and serves as a highly persuasive selling point by significantly lowering heating and cooling maintenance costs for overseas consumers.
- 1mm Ultra-Slim Mat via High-Frequency Welding
The mat is manufactured by thermally compressing two layers of fabric using high-frequency waves, eliminating the sewing process entirely. This results in outstanding water resistance and perfectly uniform quality. Without internal water hoses, heat loss is minimized, and temperature variance across the mat is negligible. With a thickness of only 1mm and a weight of 1–2kg (Single/Double), its highly compact design offers exceptional storability and portability for outdoor activities like camping.

Spatial efficiency is maximized with an ultra-compact boiler measuring just 20cm x 23.8cm x 15.7cm. All functions can be installed and operated within 5 minutes using three intuitive buttons. These ultra-small and lightweight specifications drastically reduce air and sea freight logistics costs, highly optimizing it for international trade.
- Electromagnetic Wave Shielding & Multi-Safety System
Electromagnetic wave exposure is minimized in both the boiler (0.14mG) and the mat (0.02mG). Furthermore, it guarantees consumer trust with a built-in 4-tier safety system: a water shortage sensor, an automatic 16-hour continuous operation shut-off, a backflow prevention system, and freeze protection (automatically initiates hot water circulation below 18°C and shuts off after the temperature rises by 36°C).
- Eco-Friendly Antibacterial Solution
The internal boiler tank is treated with an eco-friendly ceramic coating, preventing 99.99% of water contamination and bacterial growth, including Staphylococcus aureus. The mat itself is also treated with a non-toxic, eco-friendly coating, fully complying with strict global hygiene and environmental standards.
- Universal Voltage Support for Immediate Export
The system flawlessly supports both domestic (220V) and overseas operating voltages with a rated input of 90~240V / 50~60Hz (Rated output: DC24V/5A). This allows a single product model to be immediately exported and used in any country worldwide without the need for additional transformers or adapters.
- Comprehensive Global Safety Certifications Acquired
The product has successfully secured essential electrical and safety certifications for major global markets, including CE (Europe), UL & FCC (US), TUV (Germany), CCC (China), PSE (Japan), RCM (Australia), EAC (Eurasia & Russia), and CB, alongside domestic KC certification and broadcasting & communication equipment registration. products.name: Dust Mite Block Mattress Cover & Pillow case (Bedding products)
products.description:
A high-density woven cover that physically blocks contact between the skin and airways and the dust mites and fecal particles inside bedding during sleep. Because the barrier comes from the micro-pore structure of the fabric itself rather than chemical treatment, blocking performance does not degrade with repeated washing, and there is no concern about residual agents irritating the skin.

Key strengths

Chemical-free physical barrier — No mite repellents or insecticidal agents are used. An ultra-high-density woven fabric with a pore size of 10㎛ or less physically prevents the passage of dust mites (approximately 200–300㎛) and the fine allergen-carrying particles they leave behind. Since no active substance contacts the skin, it is suitable for sensitive skin and infant sleeping environments.

Performance retained after washing — Blocking derives from the woven structure rather than a coating or finishing treatment, so the barrier rate is maintained through repeated laundering. This is a durable product, not a consumable.

Fully enclosing construction — The pillow cover closes with a zipper and the mattress cover uses an elasticated band. Both wrap the bedding on all sides, top to bottom, leaving no route for dust mites to escape. Coverage is far broader than pad-type products that only cover the upper surface.

Comfortable sleep experience — Unlike waterproof film or laminated fabrics, the woven structure preserves breathability, minimizing heat build-up and sweating in warm weather. The hand feel is designed to be close to ordinary bedding.

Verified test data — Dust mite penetration testing by FITI Testing & Research Institute confirmed a blocking rate of 100%.

Target consumers — Consumers who need to manage their bedding environment due to allergic rhinitis or atopic dermatitis; households caring for infant and children's bedding; homes shared with pets; and consumers in humid regions where dust mite populations thrive.

Brand connection — Ruvair is a 24-hour daily care brand that addresses both what you apply to your skin and the environment you live in. Paired with the three skincare products (Calm Soothing Gel, Soft Barrier Lotion, Airy Embrace Cream), this bedding line completes a single routine spanning daytime skin care and nighttime sleep-environment care.

products.name: DrSpot DS-HUV-AS22F( air sterilizer)
products.description:
The DS-HUV-AS22F is a DrSpot HUV air sterilizer designed to manage airborne contaminants in occupied indoor environments such as hospitals, schools, offices, and public facilities. The export model is equipped with a replaceable HEPA filter that physically captures fine airborne particles. It combines HEPA filtration with plasma-ion technology that agglomerates and reduces airborne particles, as well as internally shielded HUV light-based sterilization technology.

Its compact and low-noise design makes it suitable for continuous operation in hospital rooms, classrooms, meeting rooms, offices, and other occupied spaces. The unit can be installed on a wall or ceiling or used with a stand, depending on the local environment. It measures 385 × 245 × 89 mm and weighs only 1.6 kg, allowing installation even where space is limited.

The HEPA filter used in the export model is supplied as a replaceable consumable, enabling local importers and distributors to generate recurring revenue through replacement-filter sales after the initial product purchase. Filter specifications, replacement cycles, packaging, and supply arrangements can be customized according to local air-quality conditions and the distribution strategy of each overseas partner.

For the Korean public procurement market, the product is supplied in a filter-free configuration to minimize maintenance requirements. More than 1,000 units have been supplied to public institutions, medical facilities, schools, and industrial sites in Korea. HANTECH is seeking overseas distributors, project partners, and OEM partners for the HEPA-equipped export model.

products.name: DrSpot DS-Z-APS-GX (Air Sterilizer)
products.description:
The DS-Z-APS-GX is an indoor air purification and sterilization device that combines filtration, plasma-ion technology, UVC, and 405nm light. Its display allows users to monitor PM2.5, TVOC, temperature, humidity, operating status, and remaining filter life. The product is suitable for continuous indoor air-quality management in hospitals, schools, offices, public facilities, and commercial spaces.

The export business model is designed to go beyond one-time equipment sales. Local partners can operate the product through rental or subscription-based service programs and generate recurring revenue from monthly rental fees, scheduled filter replacements, periodic inspections, maintenance services, and after-sales care.

HANTECH is seeking local importers and distributors capable of operating rental programs, replacing filters, and providing regular maintenance services. We are particularly interested in partners that can build regional sales, installation, and service networks and reach institutional and corporate customers, including hospitals, schools, businesses, and public-sector facilities.

products.name: AI fall detection solution
products.description:
Product OverviewSP-01 is an intelligent, AI-vision-based preventive care solution developed to address the chronic labor shortages and patient safety challenges faced by rehabilitation hospitals, nursing homes, and senior care facilities in the era of super-aging societies. Moving away from traditional reactive alarm systems, SP-01 detects precursor signs in real-time before an accident occurs, securing vital golden time for proactive intervention. 
- Core Features & StrengthsParadigm Shift from Reactive Detection to "Predictive Prevention"Conventional physical sensors and bed mats only trigger alarms after an incident has occurred or when a patient has already left the bed, often missing the critical golden time. In contrast, SP-01 utilizes advanced AI algorithms to detect pre-fall behaviors in real time—such as a patient moving to the edge of the bed or attempting to get up—and instantly alerts the nursing station. Uncompromising Privacy Protection (Zero Cloud Dependency)Although installed in patient rooms, the system does not stream or store raw video footage like standard CCTVs. Automatic real-time face blurring and skeletal analytics are performed entirely at the hardware level (edge computing) without touching an external cloud server, preserving patient dignity and ensuring full compliance with global data privacy regulations. Medical Staff Uniform Recognition & Workflow OptimizationThe system recognizes designated medical staff uniforms. When a nurse enters the room to care for a patient, the alert automatically dismisses and logs the event as a "Nurse Visit".This minimizes false alarms, optimizes nighttime rounds, and significantly reduces the physical and mental fatigue of chronic nursing shortages.Intuitive Monitoring & Rapid Response SupportNursing stations can monitor the real-time status of each hospital bed (e.g., in bed, exit attempt, fall) through a dedicated touch-screen control panel.When an event occurs, alerts are accompanied by a 3-second blurred GIF preview clip, enabling swift and accurate on-site responses.
- Expected Business & Operational Impact (ROI)Ensuring Patient Safety & Mitigating Liabilities: Pre-emptively blocks falls and unexpected safety accidents to protect patients while drastically reducing legal disputes and reputational risks for medical facilities.Enhancing Hospital Management Efficiency: Relieves the heavy workload of nighttime staff and lowers turnover rates driven by excessive burdens, ultimately saving recruitment and administrative costs while boosting operational net profits.

products.name: Cellreborn PDRN 3D Capsule Cream
products.description:
피부 위에서 터지는 PDRN 캡슐, 수분을 넘어 영양과 탄력까지 채우는 집중 스킨케어

셀리본 PDRN 캡슐 크림은 장미에서 유래한 식물성 PDRN과 9종의 멀티 펩타이드를 차별화된 캡슐 제형에 담아낸 프리미엄 스킨케어 제품입니다. 피부에 펴 바르는 순간 캡슐이 부드럽게 터지며 크림과 어우러지는 독특한 사용 경험을 제공해, 제품의 효능뿐 아니라 소비자가 직접 보고 느낄 수 있는 시각적·감각적 차별성까지 갖추고 있습니다.

이 제품의 핵심은 단순한 보습에 머물지 않는 영양·탄력·피부톤을 함께 고려한 멀티 케어입니다. 장미 유래 식물성 PDRN과 멀티 펩타이드가 생기 있고 탄탄해 보이는 피부를 위한 집중 케어를 제공하며, 아데노신은 탄력 및 주름 케어를, 나이아신아마이드는 맑고 화사한 피부톤을 위한 브라이트닝 케어를 완성합니다. 여기에 알란토인, 베타인, 글리세린, 트레할로스 등 보습·컨디셔닝 성분을 더해 피부를 촉촉하고 편안하게 관리할 수 있도록 설계했습니다.

특히 소비자에게 익숙한 PDRN 트렌드를 활용하면서도, 일반적으로 연상되는 연어 유래 성분이 아닌 장미 유래의 식물성 PDRN을 적용했다는 점은 셀리본 PDRN 캡슐 크림만의 중요한 차별화 포인트입니다. 캡슐이 터지는 독특한 비주얼, 탱글하고 촉촉한 사용감, PDRN과 멀티 펩타이드를 중심으로 한 성분 스토리가 결합되어 온라인 상세페이지, SNS 콘텐츠, 오프라인 시연 등 다양한 마케팅 채널에서 소비자의 관심을 효과적으로 이끌어낼 수 있습니다.

또한 한국에서는 나이아신아마이드와 아데노신을 기반으로 미백·주름개선 2중 기능성 화장품으로 소구할 수 있어, 단순한 트렌드성 PDRN 제품을 넘어 기능성과 감각적인 제품 경험을 함께 전달할 수 있는 경쟁력 있는 스킨케어 아이템입니다.

셀리본 PDRN 캡슐 크림은 ‘보이는 캡슐의 차별성’과 ‘식물성 PDRN·멀티 펩타이드의 성분 스토리’, 그리고 ‘수분·영양·탄력·브라이트닝을 아우르는 멀티 케어’를 하나의 제품에 담아낸 것이 가장 큰 강점입니다.

products.name: Cellreborn Cellrebiome Tea Tree Shampoo
products.description:
More than cleansing — a daily scalp-care shampoo designed to refresh the scalp while supporting healthier-looking, stronger-feeling hair.

CELLREBORN Cellrebiome Tea Tree Shampoo is a scalp-focused functional shampoo designed to combine deep scalp cleansing with targeted scalp and hair conditioning in one daily routine. Rather than focusing only on removing oil and buildup, the formula brings together cleansing ingredients, Korea-recognized functional hair-loss symptom care ingredients, and CELLREBORN’s patented CGE-V1 complex to create a more comprehensive scalp-care proposition.

One of the product’s strongest points of differentiation is its dual approach to cleansing and conditioning. Salicylic acid and climbazole help manage excess sebum, dead skin cells and scalp buildup, while niacinamide, biotin, panthenol and Lactobacillus are incorporated as part of the formula’s functional scalp-care system.

The formula is further differentiated by CELLREBORN’s patented CGE-V1 complex (Korean Patent No. 10-2360708), adding a proprietary technology story to the product. This allows distributors to position Cellrebiome Tea Tree Shampoo as more than a conventional tea tree cleansing shampoo: it is designed as the first step of a complete scalp-care routine, addressing scalp cleanliness, balance and hair conditioning together.

The sensory profile has also been developed for frequent use. With a mildly acidic pH of 4–6 and coconut-derived plant-based surfactants, the shampoo leaves the scalp feeling clean and refreshed with a fresh herbal scent. The formula has also undergone a skin irritation test and was confirmed within the non-irritating range, providing an additional credibility point for distributors and consumers looking for effective scalp cleansing without an unnecessarily harsh experience.

The product is formulated without silicone oil, sulfates, CMIT/MIT, BHT, mineral oil or parabens, creating a clear 6-Free formulation story that can be communicated to ingredient-conscious consumers.

In Korea, Cellrebiome Tea Tree Shampoo is classified as a functional cosmetic for the relief of hair-loss symptoms. For international markets, claim wording should be adapted according to each country’s cosmetic regulations, while its broader positioning around scalp cleansing, scalp balance, strengthening care and daily scalp maintenance provides strong marketing flexibility.

The key commercial strength of CELLREBORN Cellrebiome Tea Tree Shampoo is that it transforms an everyday cleansing step into a more complete scalp-care routine. The combination of refreshing tea tree positioning, functional scalp-care ingredients, patented CGE-V1 technology, mildly acidic formulation and a clean, refreshing sensory experience gives distributors several strong and easy-to-communicate reasons for consumers to choose the product over an ordinary shampoo.

products.name: Cellreborn Black Bean Quick Speed Hair Color
products.description:
Fast gray coverage in just 5 minutes — rich, even-looking color with conditioning care for the hair.

CELLREBORN Black Bean LPP Quick Speed Hair Color is a fast-acting oxidative hair color developed for consumers who want quick and convenient gray coverage without overlooking the condition of their hair. Rather than focusing solely on color performance, the formula combines a Black Bean ingredient story with an LPP protein system to address the dryness and rough feel that can often accompany the coloring process.

Its most immediate commercial advantage is the 5-minute quick-color concept. By significantly simplifying the waiting time associated with conventional hair coloring, the product offers a clear and easy-to-communicate benefit for time-conscious consumers seeking practical at-home gray coverage.

Hair conditioning is another important point of differentiation. The formula incorporates an LPP protein system featuring hydrolyzed collagen, hydrolyzed keratin and 17 amino acids, helping condition hair that may feel dry or stressed during coloring. Black Bean ingredients further enrich the formulation story with naturally associated components including vitamin E, unsaturated fatty acids, isoflavones and lecithin.

The formula is complemented by ceramide, shea butter and camellia oil, helping maintain softness, moisture and a glossy-looking finish after coloring. This allows distributors to position the product not simply as a gray-coverage dye, but as a quick hair-color solution that combines color performance with thoughtful conditioning care.

Another strong marketing feature is its formulation without ammonia or fragrance, providing an additional point of differentiation for consumers who prefer a less overwhelming coloring experience. Combined with its short processing time, this gives the product a highly understandable consumer proposition for retail, e-commerce and home-use hair-color channels.

CELLREBORN Black Bean LPP Quick Speed Hair Color is available in three highly practical shades: 2N Natural Black, 4N Dark Brown and 6N Natural Brown, covering the core natural color choices commonly sought for gray coverage.

The key commercial strength of CELLREBORN Black Bean LPP Quick Speed Hair Color is the combination of three simple consumer benefits: fast 5-minute gray coverage, Black Bean and LPP protein conditioning, and naturally rich, glossy-looking color. This straightforward proposition makes the product easy for distributors to communicate and gives consumers an immediate reason to understand why it is different from an ordinary hair color.

products.name: Cellreborn STAR Braid LOC Edge Gel
products.description:
Strong hold. Clean finish. Precise control for braids, locs, twists and edges.

CELLREBORN STAR Braid LOC Edge Gel is a high-hold styling gel developed specifically for braids, locs, twists, sleek styles, edges and baby hairs. Designed for textured, curly and coily hair, it provides the control needed to create clean, defined styles while helping maintain a polished finish throughout the day.

One of the product’s strongest commercial advantages is the combination of powerful hold and a clean, flake-free finish. It helps smooth and control the hair during braiding and loc styling while allowing precise shaping around the hairline and edges. Once dry, the transparent gel is designed to minimize visible white residue and flaking, an especially important performance benefit for darker hair tones.

Despite its strong styling performance, the formula is designed to avoid the excessively stiff, sticky or greasy feel often associated with heavy-hold gels. This creates a strong yet flexible styling experience, allowing professionals and consumers to achieve sleek, controlled results without sacrificing the natural appearance of the hair.

CELLREBORN also brings a conditioning dimension to the formula. Keratin, collagen, silk protein and biotin contribute to the hair-conditioning story, while jojoba seed oil helps support softness and natural-looking shine. Aloe vera, Damask rose water and ceramide provide additional moisturizing and conditioning benefits, complemented by botanical ingredients including tea tree, Centella asiatica and turmeric.

This gives distributors a stronger product story than a conventional edge-control gel. Rather than positioning the product only around fixation, CELLREBORN STAR Braid LOC Edge Gel combines styling performance, clean finish and conditioning care in one versatile formula.

Its broad styling versatility also makes it commercially attractive across both professional and consumer channels. The same product can be used for braiding, loc maintenance, twists, slick-back styles, ponytails, buns and detailed edge work, giving salons and consumers multiple reasons for repeat use.

The key strength of CELLREBORN STAR Braid LOC Edge Gel is its balance of long-lasting hold, flake-free performance and conditioning care. It addresses the core expectations of the textured-hair styling market — strong control, clean results and a polished finish — while offering a more complete formulation story than a basic styling gel.

products.name: SJC Lacto PDRN (Sodium PDRN)
products.description:
Reportedly the first of its kind developed in Korea, Lacto-PDRN is a non-animal, fermentation-derived PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide) produced through fermentation of the probiotic strain Lactobacillus rhamnosus. It resolves the supply volatility and animal-origin concerns long associated with conventional fish-derived PDRN (typically extracted from salmon milt), yielding a highly purified core active — Sodium DNA — through precision microbial fermentation and refinement.
Beyond the intrinsic regenerative capacity of PDRN in supporting cellular renewal and tissue repair, Lacto-PDRN acts as a multi-functional active with pronounced anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. It suppresses inflammatory mediators to calm reactive skin, while neutralizing oxidative stress to protect skin cells — reinforcing the skin barrier and restoring balance to compromised, irritated skin from within.
Its fermentation-based, non-animal origin offers a compelling narrative for vegan, clean-beauty, and sustainability-driven global brands, with proven versatility across sera, essences, creams, and masks in regenerative skincare formulations.

products.name: SJC Cica Repair 4 (Asiaticoside,Madecassic Acid,Asiatoc Acid)
products.description:
SJC Cica Repair 4 is a high-performance repair active in which the three core bioactive components of Centella Asiatica — Asiaticoside, Madecassic Acid, and Asiatic Acid (TECA) — are stabilized at 4% concentration through nano-liposome encapsulation technology. This approach fundamentally resolves the formulation instability and uneven dispersion long associated with conventional Centella-derived ingredients in water-phase systems, while simultaneously maximizing skin absorption and the delivery efficiency of the active components.
Beyond its potent antioxidant and anti-aging properties, SJC Cica Repair 4 functions as a multi-functional repair solution that supports the recovery of damaged skin tissue, soothes irritation, and promotes cellular regeneration. Its excellent formulation versatility — dispersible uniformly in both oil and water phases — allows seamless application across a wide range of skincare formats, from high-viscosity emulsions to essences and serums.
Already adopted by leading K-beauty brands, SJC Cica Repair 4 is a proven, formulation-stable Centella solution that OEM/ODM formulators can confidently incorporate into new product development with speed and reliability.

products.name: SJC Natural Emuls MSB (100% Natural Emulsifier system with Hydrogenated Lecithin etc)
products.description:
SJC Natural Emuls MSB is a 100% plant-derived, stand-alone emulsifier built on a precise combination of Hydrogenated Lecithin with Myristic Acid, Stearic Acid, Behenic Acid, Stearyl Alcohol, and Behenyl Alcohol. Its skin-friendly emulsification system — combining phospholipid, fatty acid, and fatty alcohol components — closely mimics the skin's own lipid structure, delivering a naturally compatible sensory feel without the residue often associated with synthetic emulsifiers.
Effective at a low usage level of just 1–5%, it forms a stable emulsification system across the full range of O/W formulation types. With an NOI (Natural Origin Index) of 1, this fully nature-derived emulsifier retains lecithin's characteristic soft, creamy sensory profile while delivering emulsifying power and texture enhancement on par with synthetic alternatives.
Purpose-built to meet the Clean Beauty movement's core demand for replacing synthetic emulsifiers, SJC Natural Emuls MSB functions as a stand-alone emulsification solution requiring no auxiliary co-emulsifiers — simplifying formulation while enabling true clean-label O/W systems for next-generation skincare.

products.name: SJC Shea Lipid30 (SJC Shea Butter 30% Delivery System)
products.description:
SJC Shea Lipid 30 is a water-solubilized lipid delivery system that stably incorporates Shea Butter — one of the most nourishing plant-derived butters — into water-based formulations at a remarkably high loading of 30%. Built on a precision emulsification framework of Hydrogenated Lecithin and Polyglyceryl-10 Stearate, it disperses and stabilizes high-content butter uniformly within the water phase, overcoming the loading limitations that have long constrained conventional oil-phase butter systems — a true next-generation Phyto-Lipid Delivery solution.
What sets it apart is its ability to translate this high-content butter system into a flowable spray format. Unlike conventional butter formulations, which tend to be heavy and slow to spread, SJC Shea Lipid 30 achieves water-like fluidity, enabling a distinctly new usage experience — moving "from butter you apply to butter you spray." It delivers a light, mist-like application while fully preserving Shea Butter's signature deep moisturizing and nourishing benefits, satisfying both effortless spreadability and rich nutritive performance at once.
As demand for butter spray formats accelerates across the body care and hair care markets, SJC Shea Lipid 30 — with its full formulation versatility and strong Clean & Natural appeal — stands out as an ideal ingredient for brands developing differentiated new formats and compelling storytelling-driven marketing.

products.name: SJC Ceramide 45 Natural (Combined with 6 Types/High level of Ceramide)
products.description:
SJC Ceramide 45 Natural is a flagship active that translates the biomimetic replication of healthy skin's lipid structure into a high-content, fully naturally derived ceramide complex. Precisely blending five ceramide types — Ceramide EOP, NS, NP, AS, and AP — with Cholesterol, it forms a six-component sphingolipid complex in which each ceramide performs a distinct function within the skin barrier, working together to create a synergistic effect.
Stabilized at an industry-leading 45% concentration in powder form, it is composed entirely of naturally derived ingredients, achieving an NOI (Natural Origin Index) of 1 In-vivo clinical data confirm measurable improvements in moisture loss and turnover cycle normalization, substantiating its powerful moisturizing and skin-barrier-reinforcing performance along with complementary benefits such as atopic care.
Available across powder, complex, and biogel platforms, SJC Ceramide 45 Natural is compatible with all formulation types — and with its fully natural-origin positioning squarely aligned to the 2026 Clean Beauty trend and robust clinical substantiation, it gives brand teams a highly persuasive story to build on.

products.name: SJC GG (Glyceryl Glucoside)
products.description:
INCI: Glyceryl Glucoside
SJC GG is a naturally derived, multifunctional moisturizer suited to a broad range of formulation types, including skin care, hair care, and cleansing products. Backed by strong moisture-binding capacity, its core skin-barrier-strengthening function effectively supports the regeneration of stressed and aged skin, while also delivering daily UV protection — allowing a single ingredient to fulfill hydration, regeneration, and sun-defense roles at once. Backed by available clinical data, it offers formulators objective, evidence-based substantiation for its performance claims.

products.name: SJC-P20MG (PPG-20 Methyl Glucose Ether)
products.description:
INCI Name: PPG-20 Methyl Glucose Ether (Humectant)
SJC-P20MG (INCI: PPG-20 Methyl Glucose Ether, a humectant/moisturizer) is a multifunctional ingredient for skin and hair care. It is generally regarded as safe (GRAS) for cosmetic use. As a humectant, it retains moisture effectively and prevents dryness in both skin and haircare formulations. It minimizes scalp damage from bleaching and other chemical treatments while reducing irritation. It also softens hair strands and delivers an excellent coating effect with UV protection. Fully compatible with cold-process manufacturing, it offers formulators an easy, energy-efficient solution.

products.name: SJC-EPDM147 (PEG/PPG-14/7 DimethylEther)
products.description:
INCI Name: PEG/PPG-14/7 Dimethyl Ether (Water-Soluble Emollient)
SJC-EPDM147 (INCI: PEG/PPG-14/7 Dimethyl Ether) is a water-soluble emollient designed for skin and hair care formulations. As part of an advanced emollient portfolio combining ester, triglyceride, and polymer technologies, it delivers immediate skin-softening benefits by smoothing the skin's surface and enhancing tactile elegance. Being water-soluble, it provides a moisturizing yet non-oily sensory feel, making it especially well suited to water-based formulations. Its amphiphilic, non-greasy nature offers excellent compatibility across aqueous systems, supporting the development of sophisticated, oil-free formulas. It fits a wide range of applications, from lightweight serums to hair care treatments, creating a smooth, supple finish. Overall, it enables formulators to achieve luxurious sensory experiences without heaviness or oiliness.

products.name: SJC-ISG T20EX (PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate)
products.description:
INCI Name: PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate (Non-ionic O/W Emulsifier, Cleansing)
SJC-ISG T20EX (INCI: PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate) is a non-ionic, PEG-20-ethoxylated glyceryl ester surfactant with an HLB value of 8, positioning it as a mild yet effective oil-in-water (O/W) emulsifying and cleansing agent. Its amphiphilic glyceryl/sorbitan-type backbone efficiently emulsifies and solubilizes sebum, makeup, and oil-based impurities, enabling clean and complete removal from the skin surface. Unlike harsh anionic surfactants, it cleanses gently without disrupting the skin barrier, leaving skin thoroughly hydrated and free of post-cleansing tightness. It is also highly effective at breaking down water-resistant, oil-based sun care formulations, ensuring residue-free rinse-off. This makes SJC-ISG T20EX a versatile emulsifier for cleansing creams, cleansing balms/oils, gentle foaming cleansers, and sun care removers. Its stable emulsification performance and skin-conditioning profile support the formulation of premium, sensory-refined cleansing products.

products.name: SJC-PGIS23 (Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate)
products.description:
INCI Name: Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate (Water-in-Oil Emulsifier, HLB 3)
SJC-PGIS23 (INCI: Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate) is a lipophilic, non-ionic polyglycerol ester with a low HLB value of 3, making it a highly effective water-in-oil (W/O) emulsifier. Its low-HLB, oil-continuous structure firmly encapsulates the water phase within the oil phase, forming a robust occlusive barrier on the skin that minimizes transepidermal water loss (TEWL) while imparting a soothing, moisturized feel. As a polyglycerol-based emulsifier, it promotes stable mixing and phase compatibility between oil and water, effectively suppressing phase separation and emulsion breakdown over time to extend product shelf life. It also functions as an excellent pigment dispersant, uniformly wetting and stabilizing inorganic UV filters and pigments—an essential property for sun care and color cosmetic formulations. Its ester-based, polyglycerol backbone further contributes strong oxidative stability, protecting the formulation from rancidity and degradation. Being plant-derived and readily biodegradable, SJC-PGIS23 supports the development of stable, sensorially refined W/O emulsions for sun care, skin care, and cleansing applications with a favorable environmental profile.

products.name: Hi Me Backpack (Kids’ Backpack)

A backpack made to be truly their own. Hi Me lets children express their personality by mixing and matching alphabet sticker patches, decorative patches, handmade straps and charms. Made from GRS-certified recycled PET fabric with a protective coating, it is resistant to scratches and stains and offers everyday water resistance. Even marks from permanent markers and ballpoint pens can be easily wiped away with a wet wipe, making daily care simple.

The open-top cylindrical structure, sturdy base panel and bottom studs allow the backpack to stand upright, making it easy for children to pack and access their belongings independently. A non-slip chest belt and thick, wide shoulder straps provide a comfortable fit. The spacious interior holds textbooks, a large lunchbox and even a 1L bottle.

A detachable coin case featuring a different motif for each colour — flower, heart, star or lightning bolt — is included. The product complies with Korean safety standards for children’s products (KC).

Sticker patches, handmade straps and charms can be freely mixed and matched, allowing children to create their own personalised style. Korean Food Grand Master No.50 Designated Product (designated by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs KOREA)
Cheonri-jang, whose mail ingredients are Gamcheonjang and Hanwoo(Korean beef), is a sauce that has been passed down from generation to generation in the Papyeiong yoon family, which literally means “You can carry it a thousand miles without getting damaged”
Cheonri-jang is a traditional Korean soy sauce with a very rich and thick taste of beef, and it is a designated product that can only be made by Yoon Wang-soon. 
Cheonri-jang is a very special type of sauce, so it wasn’t something we ate just anytime it was reserved for serving serving important guests.
Therefore, it is a traditional soy sauce that was consumed only in the royal court and by the nobility.

Eoyukjang is a precious sauce that can only be obtained by pouring fermented soybeans(Meju) and saltwater into the jar with a lot of precious and delicious meat ingredient from the sea, land, and sky, and then fermenting and ripening the jar for a year.
Therefore, it is a traditional soy sauce that was consumed only in the royal court and by the nobility.

products.name: A4 House(IoT-based Smart Paper Supply and Management System)
products.description:
● Key Features of A4 HOUSE
 A4 HOUSE is a smart copy paper management system designed for installation near multifunction printers, office printers, or other locations with high paper consumption. It stores copy paper efficiently and uses IoT technology to monitor and manage paper inventory.
 
① Storage Capacity of Up to Approximately 8,500 Sheets
 A4 HOUSE can store up to approximately 8,500 sheets of A4 copy paper while occupying a compact floor space roughly equivalent to the size of one A4 sheet. This helps organize copy paper that would otherwise be stored in boxes around printers or in separate storage areas.
 ② Real-Time Paper Level Monitoring by Location
 IoT sensors installed in each A4 HOUSE transmit paper level data to the management system. Through the management dashboard, users can check the remaining paper level in real time by customer and installation location. Device status and the latest communication time can also be monitored, allowing multiple units installed at different locations to be managed remotely.
 ③ Inventory and Replenishment Management
 Paper level data helps users identify locations that require replenishment and determine appropriate replenishment timing. Accumulated usage data can also be used to review paper consumption by department and period and support purchasing plans.

● Integrated Product and Service Model
 A key feature of A4 HOUSE is that it can be operated not only as a standalone product, but as an integrated solution combining the product, an IoT-based management system, and copy paper supply and replenishment services.

 In Korea, dedicated service personnel visit customer sites to deliver and replenish copy paper and collect packaging materials. This service model helps customers reduce repetitive tasks associated with transporting paper, opening boxes, storing paper, checking inventory, and replenishing supplies.

 A4 HOUSE is not limited to a specific industry. It can be used by companies, government and public organizations, hospitals, universities and educational institutions, financial institutions, manufacturers, and other organizations with high copy paper consumption.

● Application in Overseas Markets
 For overseas markets, A4 HOUSE can be adapted to local distribution and service environments through cooperation with local partners rather than requiring the Korean service model to be replicated exactly.

 ① Copy Paper Manufacturers and Suppliers
 A4 HOUSE can be integrated with their existing paper supply and distribution networks.
 ② MFP and Office Equipment Distributors
 The product can be added to their existing sales and maintenance networks for printers, multifunction printers, and other office equipment.
 ③ Local Service Partners
 Local partners can provide product installation, management, and paper replenishment services.

This approach enables A4 HOUSE to be introduced not only through direct product exports, but also through partnerships with local companies that already operate copy paper supply networks or office equipment sales and service networks.

<Key Highlights>
Up to approx. 8,500 A4 sheets / Real-time paper level monitoring by installation location / Remote management of multiple units through IoT technology / Inventory & replenishment management / Integration with copy paper supply and replenishment services

products.name: Industrial Cam Switch
products.description:
The SUNGHO CONTROLS SHCS Series Cam Switch is a panel-mounted, cam-operated rotary switch designed to operate multiple contacts in predefined switching sequences. It is suitable for control panels, switchboards, industrial machinery, and automation equipment. Typical applications include power ON/OFF control, circuit selection and changeover, forward and reverse motor control, motor pole changing, and voltmeter or ammeter selector switching.

The product range includes the SHCS-ET European Type, SHCS-SH/SR/SE/SP Standard Types, and SHCS-2H/3H Moisture-Resistant Types. Manual-return and spring-return mechanisms are available. Handle design, contact configuration, number of switching positions, return mechanism, front-plate color, and switching angle can be configured according to the customer’s circuit and operating requirements. Available switching angles include 30°, 45°, 60°, and 90°, with configurations ranging from 2 to 12 switching positions depending on the selected specification.

For flexible panel installation, the series is available in 40×40 mm and 48×48 mm square types, as well as Ø25 mm and Ø30 mm round mounting types. The standard contact rating is 10 A, while customized 20 A and 30 A versions are available for applications requiring higher current capacity.

The SHCS Series is KC-certified and CE-certified. It provides an electrical life of more than 100,000 operations and a mechanical life of more than 500,000 operations. The operating temperature range is -20°C to +70°C, and the switch withstands AC 1,500 V at 50/60 Hz for one minute, providing reliable circuit control in industrial equipment and electrical-panel environments.

With its standardized construction, flexible circuit configuration, and controlled manufacturing process, the SHCS Series offers reliable contact operation and long service life. It is suitable for control panel builders, switchboard manufacturers, industrial machinery manufacturers, automation system integrators, and industrial electrical component distributors.

products.name: PR series Square Light&Pushbutton Switch
products.description:
The SUNGHO CONTROLS PR Series Industrial Pushbutton Switches are panel-mounted control devices designed for operating and signaling functions in switchboards, control panels, industrial machinery, and automation equipment. They are suitable for equipment start/stop control, operating commands, circuit control, and emergency-stop applications. Two panel mounting sizes, Ø25 mm and Ø30 mm, are available.

The product range includes non-illuminated flush-head pushbuttons, mushroom-head emergency-stop switches, and LED-illuminated flush-head pushbuttons. Non-illuminated flush-head models feature a spring-return mechanism and are available with 1NO+1NC, 2NO+2NC, or 3NO+3NC contact configurations. Mushroom-head emergency switches are available with either spring-return or manual-reset operation and with 1NO+1NC or 2NO+2NC contacts. Illuminated models use high-brightness LEDs for clear operating-status indication and support various control voltages, including AC 110/120/220/230/380/440 V and DC 24/110 V.

An integrated operator and contact-unit structure provides durability and stable operation. The slide-type contact mechanism supports reliable switching in low-voltage control circuits, while the transparent contact housing allows the operating condition to be visually inspected during installation and maintenance. A terminal protection cover is supplied as standard to improve wiring safety, and optional protective covers are available for selected models.

The contact rating is 5 A at 250 VAC for resistive loads and 3 A at 250 VAC for inductive loads. The electrical life is more than 100,000 operations. The mechanical life exceeds 1,000,000 operations for non-illuminated pushbuttons and 500,000 operations for illuminated models. The operating temperature range is -5°C to +40°C. The products withstand AC 1,500 V between live parts and AC 2,500 V between live and non-live parts.

The PR Series is KC-certified and CE-certified. Its selectable mounting size, button color, contact configuration, return mechanism, and illumination voltage make it suitable for control panel builders, switchboard manufacturers, industrial machinery manufacturers, automation system integrators, and industrial electrical component distributors.

products.name: Industrial Buzzer
products.description:
SUNGHO Industrial Buzzers are electric audible signaling devices designed to notify operators of equipment status, abnormal conditions, operation completion, and warning events in switchboards, control panels, industrial machinery, and automation equipment. Mechanical, electronic, panel-mounted, and exposed-type models are available to meet different installation and signaling requirements.

The product range includes compact buzzers for Ø25 mm and Ø30 mm panel mounting, powerful panel-mounted buzzers requiring a Ø66 mm panel cutout, and exposed-type powerful buzzers that can be installed without flush mounting. Their compact construction and straightforward mounting design allow convenient installation, maintenance, and replacement in existing control panels and industrial equipment.

Mechanical buzzers are available in AC 110 V and AC 220 V versions. Depending on the model, they consume between 4 W and 8 W and provide a sound pressure level of approximately 75-80 dB. Electronic buzzers support various power supplies, including AC 110-220 V, DC 12-24 V, DC 110-125 V, and DC 110-220 V. Electronic models consume 4 W and provide a sound pressure level of approximately 70-80 dB, depending on the selected model.

The compact SH-EB-25 and SH-EB-30 electronic models offer selectable fast intermittent, slow intermittent, and continuous tones through different terminal connections. This allows users to assign distinctive audible signals to different equipment conditions or warning levels.

The buzzers provide an insulation resistance of at least 100 MΩ at 500 VDC and withstand 1,000 VAC for one minute between live and non-live parts. They operate within an ambient temperature range of -10°C to +55°C and a relative humidity range of 45-85%, supporting reliable operation in general industrial control-panel and machinery environments.

With multiple mounting sizes, power-supply options, and selectable sound modes, the product range is suitable for control panel builders, switchboard manufacturers, industrial machinery manufacturers, factory automation system integrators, and industrial electrical component distributors.

products.name: Industrial Relay
products.description:
SUNGHO Industrial Electromagnetic Relays use low-power control signals to switch load circuits while providing reliable signal transfer and electrical isolation between control and load circuits. They are suitable for switchboards, control panels, power supplies, machine tools, molding machines, industrial machinery, robots, medical equipment, and a wide range of automation systems.

The product range consists of MY Series sequence relays, LY Series power relays, MP Series miniature power relays, and IR04 Series DIN-rail interface relay modules. Depending on the application and load requirements, customers can select 2-pole, 3-pole, or 4-pole configurations with a broad range of AC and DC operating coil voltages.

The MY Series is a compact plug-in relay designed for signal transfer and general control circuits. The 2-pole model provides a rated continuous current of up to 5 A, while the 4-pole model provides up to 3 A. The maximum switching voltage is 220 VAC or 125 VDC. Models with an operation indicator and optional surge-protection circuit are available. Arc barriers around the contacts help suppress arcing and improve durability.

The LY Series is designed for applications requiring greater load capacity. Its 2-pole and 4-pole models provide a rated continuous current of up to 10 A and are suitable for switching loads in power supplies, industrial machinery, and automation equipment. Operation-indicator and surge-protection options are available. The MY and LY Series are UL Recognized Components with cURus certification.

The MP Series is a compact power relay designed to switch relatively high loads where installation space is limited. The 2-pole model provides a rated continuous current of 7.5 A, while the 3-pole model provides 5 A. Plug-in socket and PCB-terminal configurations are available. With an electrical life exceeding 200,000 operations and a mechanical life exceeding 5 million operations, the MP Series is suitable for industrial equipment requiring frequent and long-term switching.

The IR04 Interface Relay electrically isolates low-power control signals from load circuits, supporting reliable operation in PLC and automation control systems. It supports both NPN and PNP control signals and provides LED indicators for convenient input and output monitoring. Fence-type terminals, a protective shield cover, a flame-retardant PC+ABS housing, and standard DIN-rail mounting improve wiring reliability, protection, and installation efficiency. The rated continuous current is 5 A, and the maximum switching voltage is 250 VAC or 30 VDC. The operating temperature range is -40°C to +70°C, and the IR04 Series is CE-certified.

With multiple coil voltages, contact configurations, operation indicators, and surge-protection options, these relays are suitable for control panel builders, switchboard manufacturers, industrial machinery manufacturers, automation system integrators, and industrial electrical component distributors.

products.name: Industrial Analog Timer
products.description:
SUNGHO CONTROLS Industrial Analog Timers are time-delay relays designed for sequential control and delayed switching in control panels, switchboards, industrial machinery, and factory automation systems. Using a dedicated IC-based frequency-division control system, the timers operate their output contacts after a preset time interval, enabling reliable operating sequences for motors, pumps, heaters, lighting systems, and other electrical equipment.

The product range includes the MT Mini Timer, L, M and N Series Timers, and the T Series Twin Timer. Depending on the model, selectable timing ranges are available from approximately 0.05 seconds up to 48 hours. The front-mounted analog dial allows operators to set the required delay time easily during installation and maintenance. The MT Series is suitable for ON-delay control, while the T Series Twin Timer provides repetitive ON/OFF timing control for cyclic machine operation.

Red LED indicators provide clear visual confirmation of the power supply and timer output status. Surface-mounting, flush-mounting and socket-connected models are available, allowing flexible installation in both new equipment and existing control panels.

Depending on the model, available control voltages include AC 110 V, AC 220 V and DC 24 V, with various output contact configurations. The MT Series provides a contact rating of 3 A at AC 250 V for a resistive load. The L, M, N and T Series provide contact ratings of 10 A at AC 125 V, 5 A at AC 250 V, or 8 A at DC 30 V for resistive loads. The timers operate within an ambient temperature range of -10°C to 55°C and feature low power consumption and stable repeat operation.

Typical applications include industrial control panels, switchboards, machine tools, factory automation equipment, motor and pump control, heater control, lighting control, conveyors, packaging machines, and other systems requiring preset time-delay or repetitive ON/OFF control.

products.name: Floatless Level Switches
products.description:
SUNGHO CONTROLS Floatless Level Controller is an industrial liquid-level control device designed to automatically operate pumps and filling or draining systems in water tanks, reservoirs, and industrial equipment. It detects changes in electrical resistance and conductivity between the liquid and electrode rods. Its floatless sensing method eliminates the need for a mechanical float, making it suitable for compact installations and remote level-control applications.

The product range includes the SHF-60M Standard Type for water and general conductive liquids and the SHF-60H High-Sensitivity Type for liquids with relatively high specific resistance. The SHF-60M provides a maximum sensing distance of 1 km and an operating resistance range of 0 to 7 kΩ. The SHF-60H provides a maximum sensing distance of 50 m and an operating resistance range of 15 to 70 kΩ. The appropriate model can be selected according to the conductivity of the liquid and the distance between the controller and electrodes.

In filling control applications, the controller stops the pump when the liquid reaches the upper-level electrode E1 and restarts the pump when the level falls below the lower-level electrode E2. It can also be configured for draining control by changing the terminal connection, providing flexible operation for various liquid-level management systems.

An LED operating indicator allows easy monitoring of the power and output status. The compact 8-pin socket-mounted design simplifies installation, replacement, and maintenance inside control panels. The rated supply voltage is AC 220 V at 60 Hz or AC 230 V at 50/60 Hz. The output contact rating is 5 A at AC 250 V for a resistive load, with a response time of 20 ms or less. The operating temperature range is -10°C to 60°C, and maximum power consumption is 3.2 VA.

Optional accessories include 3-pole, 4-pole and 5-pole electrode holders and SUS 304 stainless-steel electrode rods. The electrode rods have a diameter of 5 mm and are available in 1 m and 2 m lengths. Typical applications include water tanks, reservoirs, water supply systems, water-treatment equipment, building filling and draining systems, industrial pump control, and automated liquid-level management systems.

products.name: Detection Devices
products.description:
SUNGHO CONTROLS Industrial Detection Switches are mechanically operated contact switches designed to detect machine position, travel limits, movement, and the passage of objects and convert the detected motion into an electrical control signal. The product range includes industrial limit switches and V and Z Series micro switches for position detection, interlocking, safety control, and equipment sequencing.

The SHLS Series Limit Switches are available with six actuator types: adjustable roller lever, fixed lever, spring lever, roller plunger, adjustable pin lever, and ball plunger. The appropriate actuator can be selected according to the mounting position, operating direction, and movement of the machine. Each model is available with or without an operation indicator lamp. The standard 1NO+1NC contact configuration is suitable for machine stopping, direction switching, position confirmation, and interlock control.

The SHLS Series features a robust structure designed for resistance to heat, oil, dust, vibration, and mechanical impact. The enclosure provides IP67 protection. Contact ratings for resistive loads include 10 A at AC 125 V, 6 A at AC 250 V, and 4 A at AC 480 V. The series provides a mechanical life of more than 5 million operations and an electrical life of more than 500,000 operations. The operating temperature range is -10°C to 80°C. KC-certified and CE-compliant models are available depending on the product configuration.

The V Series Micro Switch is a compact snap-action switch that provides reliable contact switching with a small operating force and short actuator travel. Models are available with AC 250 V ratings of 3 A, 6 A, 11 A, 16 A, and 21 A. A wide range of actuators and terminal configurations is available, including pin plungers, hinge levers, long levers, and roller levers. SPDT, SPST-NO, and SPST-NC contact configurations are supported, with a mechanical life of more than 10 million operations.

The Z Series Micro Switch provides a high switching capacity of 15 A at AC 250 V and reliable contact performance. Its arc-resistant, flame-retardant, and heat-resistant construction provides dependable operation in industrial equipment. Various hinge and roller lever lengths are available for applications requiring short operating strokes, long displacement detection, or limited installation space.

Typical applications include machine-tool positioning, conveyor and material-handling detection, machine travel-limit detection, door and cover interlocks, industrial control panels, vending machines, copiers, household appliances, medical equipment, communication equipment, and factory automation systems.

products.name: Terminal Blocks and Sockets
products.description:
SUNGHO CONTROLS Industrial Terminal Blocks and Sockets are electrical connection components designed to provide secure power distribution and control-signal wiring in switchboards, control panels, machine tools, and industrial automation equipment. The product range includes fixed-type, modular, test and short-circuit terminal blocks, LED indicator and covered fuse holders, MY and LY relay sockets, and 8-pin and 11-pin relay/timer sockets.

The Fixed-Type Terminal Blocks feature an integrated construction that requires no individual terminal assembly. Models are available with current ratings from 10 A to 600 A and a rated insulation voltage of AC 600 V. Configurations from 3 to 20 poles are available. Brass terminals, flame-retardant polycarbonate bodies, and transparent protective covers provide reliable insulation, mechanical strength, and clear terminal identification. Stainless-steel terminal bolts are available for marine, chemical, and other corrosive environments.

The Modular Terminal Blocks are available with current ratings from 10 A to 200 A. Individual terminals can be assembled on a DIN rail according to the required number of circuits and current capacity. An internal spring mechanism automatically raises the terminal screw to reduce wiring time. Terminals with different current ratings and relay or timer sockets can be installed on the same rail. Separators, end stops, dust covers, marking strips, and other accessories are also available.

The Test Terminal Blocks are designed for testing, inspection, maintenance, and calibration of power meters and protection relays. They allow CT and PT circuits to be safely connected or isolated. A dual-contact structure consisting of main and auxiliary contacts helps prevent unintended circuit interruption during testing. The products are available in 3-pole and 4-pole configurations with a rated insulation voltage of AC/DC 500 V and a rated current of 10 A.

The Short-Circuit Terminal Blocks use shorting bolts to create short-circuit and branching connections between selected terminals. Fixed and DIN-rail-mounted configurations are available with 2 to 12 poles. The rated insulation voltage is AC/DC 250 V, and the rated current is 30 A.

The Fuse Holder Series is designed to securely accommodate circuit-protection fuses in switchboards and industrial equipment. The LED indicator type provides immediate visual identification when a fuse blows, while the covered and ceramic types provide convenient fuse inspection and replacement. DIN-rail and screw-mounted configurations are available, with circuit ratings of up to 15 A depending on the model.

The MY and LY Relay Sockets and the 8-pin and 11-pin Relay/Timer Sockets provide secure electrical connections for industrial relays and timers. DIN-rail and screw-mounting options simplify installation, replacement, and maintenance. Depending on the model, rated currents of 7 A or 10 A at AC 250 V are available.

Typical applications include switchboards, control panels, machine tools, factory automation systems, power metering and protection circuits, marine equipment, water-treatment facilities, building electrical systems, and general industrial power and control wiring.
