products.description:
AI-based security network-suitable real-time collaborative intelligent platform (Powered 3T)
The platform features a modular architecture, allowing organizations to selectively Configuration only the functions they require.
With a DMZ Proxy Structure, external information retrieval is performed under strict access controls, while internal data and documents are securely prevented from being transferred outside the organization. 
This architecture provides a high level of security suitable for organizations handling sensitive information.
1) Video conferencing system
The high-immersion video conferencing software based on Vision AI breaks away from the simple video and audio transmission model of existing video conferencing solutions. 
By applying patent-based bidirectional multicast tunneling technology and distributed processing server technology, it is implemented as a large-scale video collaboration solution that enables efficient use of network and server resources even in environments where a large number of users participate simultaneously
2) Real-Time Meeting Minutes Generation (TaiS)
By recognizing real-time STT speech, it generates meeting minutes within an average of 80 seconds (±10 seconds) after the end of meeting(based on 30 minutes), and provides meeting minutes optimized for each organization through sliding window-based meeting context summarization and terminology refinement, as well as institution-specific customization.
3) Real-time Translation (TaiT)
By applying real-time translation technology through STT-LLM integrated with during meetings, translations are displayed on the real-time auto-subtitle viewing screen within 1.5 seconds after speaking.
This allows international participants to communicate and participate comfortably in multilingual video conferences, regardless of the language being spoken.
4) AI Assistant (TaiA)
It was designed as an approval-based AI intervention Structure that operates only in response to the meeting facilitator’s queries, and implemented as an RAG·Agent architecture based on a summary of the meeting context when a query arises
 By separating the dedicated LLM to ensure stability, and through the DMZ Proxy Structure, External lookup is conducted in a controlled manner while internal documents are designed not to be taken out of the system,
thereby enhancing security and securing the level of safety and stability required for public systems, making it suitable for security-sensitive companies such as public institutions and financial firms

Real-Time Two-Way Control Platform (Moculis)
 - Moculis is a real-time situational awareness and mission replay platform that integrates GPS tracking, rear-camera video streaming, and remote command control into one unified system.
 - Designed for field operations where every second counts, Moculis allows command centers to visualize live unit locations on a high-resolution map, control rear-facing cameras remotely, and issue voice instructions to operatives wearing belt-mounted mobile devices.
 - Unlike traditional CCTVs or standalone tracking tools, Moculis synchronizes live video, location, and mission flow — enabling instant decisions during the event and precise after-action analysis afterward.
 - Moculis is an innovative solution that utilizes the camera and GPS capabilities of the smartphone to monitor the on-site situation in real time in the control room and enable two-way communication and precision analysis (screen zoom in/out).
 - It controls multiple sites at the same time and displays location-based information on the map, which has great potential for use in various public sectors such as industrial site safety management, road situation identification, and disaster/disaster site response.

The Twingty Interdental Toothbrush is designed to target areas that are difficult to clean precisely with a regular toothbrush. It complements your regular brushing routine by providing extra attention where it is needed.

Its key strength is its elastic handle and distinctive “Twist & Go” technique. A gentle twist-and-release motion uses the handle’s resilience to help brush hard-to-reach spaces. This design brings the movement of the handle into the cleaning process, alongside the shape of the bristles. The flexible handle also makes it easier to adjust the brushing angle in confined areas and is designed to provide a gentle brushing experience.

Another brand strength is that Twingty was developed by a Korean patent attorney—an intellectual property expert. Its development story connects an everyday brushing challenge with a thoughtful approach to product structure and use. The handle’s visible bending and twisting movements also make its distinctive features easy to demonstrate in videos and in person, helping consumers and buyers understand the concept quickly.

By combining a small, targeted brush head with a flexible, elastic handle, Twingty offers a practical approach to detailed cleaning. Its core message is simple: “Flexible, precise care for the spaces everyday brushing can miss.”

When excessive force is applied, the flexible neck bends naturally, providing visual and tactile feedback that helps users recognize when they are pressing too hard. As the pressure is reduced, it returns to its original shape, encouraging a lighter touch and more mindful brushing habits.

The flexible structure also helps the bristles follow the contours of the teeth. By adapting to brushing movements, it supports close contact with tooth surfaces and the gumline for careful, controlled cleaning. TWINGTY ALWAYS combines the flexibility of the toothbrush body with the action of the bristles to create a comfortable brushing experience.

Its elastic structure also makes care after brushing more convenient. The “Twist & Go” feature uses the rotational movement released by twisting and letting go of the handle to help shake excess water from the bristles. This makes it easier to remove residual moisture before storing the toothbrush in a well-ventilated place.

TWINGTY ALWAYS brings practical benefits to both brushing and toothbrush care. Its responsive flexibility helps users adjust their brushing pressure, follow the contours of their teeth, and remove excess water afterward—all through a simple design made for everyday use.

products.name: REPAIRON PERFEXIN GF CREAM
products.description:
REPAIRON is a Korean derma-cosmetic brand. Its signature product, **REPAIRON PERFEXIN G.F. CREAM**, is used in dermatology clinics and aesthetic centers in Korea and is also sold at pharmacies in Myeongdong, Seongsu, and Gangnam, popular destinations for international visitors.

Based on the practical experience of skincare professionals, as well as research and testing, REPAIRON develops products focused on skin barrier care and skin recovery for sensitive and stressed skin. Our products provide rich moisture and nourishment to the skin, helping create a hydrated, dewy complexion while also offering care for skin elasticity and visible signs of aging.

Our signature product contains key ingredients including D-Panthenol 20,000 ppm, PDRN, EGF, and 13 types of Peptides**, selected to support the skin barrier and overall skin condition. In particular, Argireline® (INCI: Acetyl Hexapeptide-8) is a well-known anti-aging ingredient often referred to as a “Botox peptide.” It helps reduce the appearance of expression lines and promotes smoother-looking skin. Matrixyl® is another renowned peptide ingredient known for supporting collagen production, helping improve the appearance of skin elasticity and wrinkles for a firmer, more youthful-looking complexion.

By combining D-Panthenol, PDRN, EGF, and high-performance peptide ingredients** in one product, REPAIRON offers a comprehensive skincare solution covering skin barrier care, hydration and nourishment, as well as elasticity and anti-aging care.

Since 2026, REPAIRON has been actively expanding into international markets, including the United States,Thailand, and Japan. Building on its experience in overseas markets, including participation in a K-Beauty pop-up event in New York, REPAIRON continues to expand its global presence.

Moving forward, REPAIRON aims to actively identify local buyers and distribution partners as part of its continued global expansion, introducing the expertise and functional strengths of REPAIRON, a Korean derma-cosmetic brand, to international markets.

products.name: Tropicalmood Sensitive Skin Recovery Plaster Pack
products.description:
The Tropicalmood Sensitive Skin Recovery Plaster Stick Pack is an innovative stick-type plaster mask designed to solve the inconvenience of traditional modeling masks and plaster packs.

Conventional modeling masks require mixing powder with water and can be messy and inconvenient to clean after use. In contrast, the Tropicalmood Sensitive Skin Recovery Plaster Stick Pack is developed in a convenient stick format, allowing anyone to apply it easily and hygienically without additional tools or preparation.

One of the most important considerations during product development was the consumer's first-use experience.

The formula delivers an instant cooling sensation upon application and glides smoothly onto the skin, providing a comfortable and pleasant user experience. It adheres evenly to the skin, helping users enjoy a relaxing home aesthetic treatment.

After cleansing, apply the product evenly to the skin and leave it on for 5–10 minutes. Rinse off with lukewarm water to experience the benefits of skin soothing, hydration, sebum control, and pore care.

Compared to conventional sheet masks, the product offers significantly more applications per unit, making it a highly cost-effective solution for daily or regular skincare routines.

---

# Key Differentiation Points

### ① Improved Convenience Over Traditional Modeling Masks

* No need to mix with water
* No additional tools required
* Easy to wash off
* Hygienic and convenient application

### ② Innovative Stick-Type Plaster Mask

* Easy to carry and store
* Maximized user convenience
* Ideal for home care and travel use

### ③ Enhanced First-Use Experience

* Instant cooling effect
* Smooth and soft application
* High user satisfaction

### ④ Specialized Care for Sensitive Skin

* Helps soothe irritated skin
* Provides hydration and moisture
* Supports sebum and pore management

### ⑤ Unique Market Positioning

* A differentiated stick-type plaster mask concept
* Creates a new category within the home aesthetic skincare market
* Limited direct competition in the current market

---

# Target Consumers

* Consumers with sensitive skin
* Individuals concerned about excess sebum and enlarged pores
* Consumers seeking simple and convenient home skincare solutions
* Women aged 20–40
* Global consumers interested in K-Beauty trends
* Active users of social media and live-commerce platforms

products.name: Scalp-Balancing Anti-Hair Loss Shampoo
products.description:
NUHAV Shampoo is not simply a functional shampoo focused on anti-hair loss benefits, but a daily scalp care product developed to combine functional efficacy with a comfortable user experience. Unlike conventional functional shampoos that primarily differentiate themselves through ingredients or claimed benefits, NUHAV views the scalp as the starting point of hair care and connects functionality, usability, design, and lifestyle into one cohesive product experience.

In particular, NUHAV targets consumers who have used functional scalp-care shampoos but have been dissatisfied with their overall user experience. While maintaining its functional positioning, the product places strong emphasis on comfortable daily use. Based on a mildly acidic formula, it incorporates functional ingredients designed to support scalp health while combining effective cleansing with a soft and comfortable feel, allowing consumers to incorporate functional scalp care naturally into their everyday routine.

The product is also not limited to consumers specifically concerned about hair loss. It is designed to appeal to wellness-oriented consumers who are increasingly interested in scalp and hair care as part of their daily self-care routine. This allows buyers to position NUHAV not only within the functional anti-hair loss category, but also within the broader scalp-care and premium daily hair-care market, providing flexibility to adapt the product to local consumer needs and distribution channels.

From a functional perspective, NUHAV Shampoo features anti-hair loss functionality recognized under Korean MFDS standards, together with a scalp-soothing complex and a fresh-volume effect. These functional elements are combined with the product’s focus on everyday usability, creating a more complete scalp-care experience beyond functionality alone.

Ultimately, the key competitive advantage of NUHAV Shampoo is not simply that it is a Korean anti-hair loss functional shampoo, but that it combines the credibility of Korean functional cosmetics with scalp-focused care, comfortable daily use, personal style, and lifestyle-oriented branding. This positioning enables NUHAV to offer buyers a differentiated Korean hair-care product that can appeal to consumers seeking both functional results and an enjoyable everyday care experience.

products.name: Scalp-Balancing Anti-Hair Loss Treatment
products.description:
NUHAV Treatment is not a conventional hair treatment focused solely on making the hair soft and smooth. Instead, it is an intensive care product developed around scalp and hair concerns associated with hair loss. For consumers concerned about hair loss, factors such as scalp condition, hair volume, and overall hair appearance can be more important than simply achieving soft, sleek hair. NUHAV developed the product with these needs in mind, giving it a distinct role within the overall hair-care routine.

Rather than focusing exclusively on the hair, NUHAV Treatment considers both scalp and hair care while maintaining a clear distinction between their respective roles. AHA and BHA are incorporated for scalp exfoliation, while intensive nourishment is provided for the hair. Used together with the shampoo, the treatment complements the scalp-focused cleansing routine and creates a more comprehensive home-care system from the scalp to the ends of the hair.

NUHAV also focuses on “volume” as an important concern for consumers experiencing hair-loss concerns. Instead of pursuing a heavy, overly smooth finish, the brand is developing a separate Hair Cream to address hair volume and styling as the next step of the routine. The upcoming Hair Cream is designed as the final step of the hair-care routine, with a lightweight texture, non-sticky finish, protein layering, and an immediate visual effect.

Therefore, the key differentiation of NUHAV Treatment is that it is not simply a conventional treatment for damaged hair. It is part of a scalp-centered hair-care system developed from real consumer concerns surrounding hair loss, with distinct roles for scalp care, hair care, and ultimately volume and styling.

products.name: Gluten cook(GluD)(보조제, 식품원료)
products.description:
Gluten, which has become an issue not only in Korea but also overseas, is known to cause various problems after consuming wheat-based foods, ranging from minor digestive discomfort to more serious conditions such as allergies, leaky gut syndrome, gluten sensitivity, and celiac disease.
Gluten cook(GluD) is a patented product containing gluten-degrading lactic acid bacteria and heat-killed lactic acid bacteria, developed to break down gluten in wheat flour, which is known to cause various health concerns, and to help treat, relieve, and prevent inflammation caused by gluten.
This product is a postbiotic product composed of a total of four types of patented lactic acid bacteria and heat-killed bacteria, including gluten-degrading lactic acid bacteria and anti-obesity lactic acid bacteria, as well as five types of lactic acid bacteria and heat-killed bacteria for gut health.
In addition, Gluten cook(GluD) can be consumed before or after eating wheat-based foods to help reduce gluten-related issues. It can also be applied in the production of gluten-reduced foods by adding the product during the fermentation process when making wheat-based foods such as bread and noodles.
In Korea, Gluten cook(GluD) has been supplied to Homeplus Bakery, A Twosome Place, and iCOOP Korea Consumer Cooperative. Overseas, it has been exported to China and Japan.

products.name: MICRO SWITCH
products.description:
A microswitch is a switch that quickly and accurately toggles an electrical circuit (ON/OFF) in response to slight physical movement. They are commonly used to detect the position or operation of mechanical equipment.
Short travel distance: Contacts switch even with minimal actuator movement.
Rapid response: Mechanical motion is instantly converted into an electrical signal.
Precise switching action: Contacts switch at a specific operating point, ensuring relatively accurate detection positioning.
High repeatability: Consistent operation is maintained over repeated cycles under identical conditions.
Diverse actuator types: Various forms—such as plungers, levers, and roller levers—are available to suit specific installation environments.
Compact and lightweight: Easy to install even in confined spaces.
Wide range of electrical ratings: Products can be selected based on the application, ranging from low-level signal detection to switching relatively high loads.
Strengths of microswitches: Microswitches are position-sensing switches that utilize small movements to quickly and accurately toggle electrical signals; they excel in compactness, high reliability, and repetitive operation.
Typical applications
Industrial automation equipment, robotics and motion control systems, printers and multifunction devices, elevators and various safety mechanisms
Automotive and vehicle systems, home appliances, door/cover open-close detection, and detection of mechanical positions and limit points.

Unlike the OEM design, which uses twin-tube construction front and rear, ELPRO adopts a mono-tube structure at the rear, increasing oil capacity for greater stability, faster response, and improved durability. ELPRO is available for major domestic and export vehicle models including the Kia Carnival, Hyundai Palisade, and Santa Fe/Sorento, and has an established market track record with a 4.9-star customer rating (48 reviews). Developed by IBS Implant (Innobiosurg), these advanced dental implant and overdenture systems are engineered around the philosophy of Minimally Invasive Implant Surgery (MIIS). products.name: IOREX (Water Pipe Treatment System)
products.description:
IOREX is an ionization-based water pipe treatment device that is installed directly on water pipes to help prevent and remove the formation of rust, scale, slime, and biofilm inside the piping system.

IOREX is the world’s first product to apply Carbon Electrode technology. It requires no chemicals or external power and continuously delivers its performance by utilizing the flow of water within the piping system itself as its power source. The carbon electrode can be used semi-permanently, eliminating the need for regular component replacement and significantly reducing maintenance costs and management efforts.

Conventional pipe management methods often require continuous maintenance, such as the use of chemicals and filter replacement, or provide only temporary results. IOREX was developed to overcome these limitations and provide a long-term, sustainable pipe management solution.

IOREX can be applied to a wide range of water treatment and pipe management applications, including municipal water supply and distribution systems, industrial facilities, factories and plants, HVAC and hot-water systems in buildings, agricultural water piping, commercial facilities, and residential plumbing.

With more than 20 years of experience in technology development and field applications, IOREX provides a sustainable and cost-effective long-term solution for pipe management, rather than simply offering short-term water treatment.

products.name: “ALPANGPANG Animal Welfare Chicken Nesting Box”
products.description:
ALPANGPANG Animal Welfare Chicken Nesting Box
Product Introduction & Assembly Instructions
Product Introduction

The ALPANGPANG Chicken Nesting Box is a patented, high-quality plastic nesting system designed with animal welfare, durability, hygiene, and convenience in mind.

The product is manufactured using high-quality plastic materials suitable for kitchenware applications, providing excellent durability and a sturdy structure for long-term use.

ALPANGPANG is more than a conventional nesting box. It incorporates practical design features developed to provide hens with a comfortable laying environment while making egg collection and farm management easier.

Key Features

- Comfortable and secure laying environment
The nesting space is designed to provide hens with a cozy and comfortable environment, helping reduce stress and anxiety during egg laying.

- Separation of eggs from hens
The system is designed so that laid eggs can be separated from hens, helping reduce problems associated with egg-eating hens and broody hens.

- Convenient egg collection
Clean eggs can be conveniently collected from either inside or outside the chicken coop, depending on the installation method and coop structure.

- Flexible installation
Part No. 4, the nesting-box cover, can be installed in different orientations according to the structure of the chicken coop. This provides greater flexibility for different farm layouts.

- Designed for large-scale installation
When multiple ALPANGPANG nesting boxes are installed together, the system can be configured for integration with an egg conveyor system, making it suitable for larger poultry operations.

These practical features distinguish ALPANGPANG from conventional chicken nesting boxes.

ALPANGPANG Nesting Box Assembly Instructions

The ALPANGPANG nesting box consists of several components, each identified by a part number.

Important: When assembling the product, position each component so that its part number is visible from above whenever applicable.

Step 1 – Prepare Part No. 4

Unfold Part No. 4

Install the entrance curtain at the marked position on the front section.

Turn the component over and secure the rectangular curtain at the designated mounting points.

Step 2 – Assemble Parts No. 1 and No. 2

Unfold Part No. 1 with the number facing upward.

You will find pointed locking tabs on both sides of the middle section of the floor panel.

Identify the front and rear sections by checking the folding lines, and gently fold and unfold the flexible sections before assembly.

Raise the front folded section.

Position Part No. 2, the side wall, vertically and insert it onto the pointed locking tabs on the front section.

Secure the wall with screws.

Press the additional locking tabs located between Parts No. 1 and No. 2 firmly into place.

Secure the rear connection between Parts No. 1 and No. 2 with screws.

Install the second Part No. 2 side wall using the same procedure.

Turn the assembled structure over and secure the bottom section with screws.

Step 3 – Install Part No. 3 and the Floor Cushion

Place the black sponge strip along the folding line of Part No. 3 and align it with the length of the component.

Lightly secure the sponge approximately 40 mm from both sides of the folding section using screws.

Bend the front folding section of Part No. 3 to approximately 90 degrees.

Insert the two pointed pins at the end of Part No. 3 into the designated holes in the floor of Part No. 1.

Once positioned correctly, the floor will naturally form the designed slope.

The sloped floor helps eggs move toward the egg-collection area.

If Part No. 3 becomes curved after extended use, it may be turned over and used on the opposite side when appropriate.

Regular cleaning of the nesting-box interior is also recommended to maintain a clean and comfortable environment for the hens.

Step 4 – Install Part No. 4

Install the previously prepared Part No. 4 cover with curtain.

Depending on the chicken-coop structure, the cover can be rotated and installed in either direction and then secured with screws.

For normal operation, the developer recommends configuring the nesting box so that hens enter through the front entrance.

Step 5 – Install the Egg Collection Cover

Finally, install Part No. 5, the cover for the egg-collection area.

Once Part No. 5 is secured, the basic assembly is complete.

There are holes on both ends of the cover. A rope or cord can be connected through these holes so that multiple egg-collection covers can be opened simultaneously, making egg collection more convenient.

After assembling one nesting unit, additional units can be connected using the same procedure.

The modular design allows multiple units to be continuously connected, including installations of 100–200 units or more, depending on the poultry-farm layout.

Installation Recommendations

For a horizontally installed nesting system, we recommend providing an entrance platform approximately 30 cm wide.

Wire mesh or wooden slats can be used for the platform. This design helps reduce the amount of dirt and manure carried into the nesting box on the hens' feet and allows waste to fall through more easily.

Larger chickens can also use the nesting box. However, if a large bird has difficulty turning around inside the nest, the center section of Part No. 2 side wall can be modified appropriately to provide additional space.

If you purchase a 5-compartment nesting-box set and wish to divide it into separate 2-compartment and 3-compartment units, one additional side-wall panel can be purchased.

Why Choose ALPANGPANG?

ALPANGPANG Animal Welfare Chicken Nesting Box has been developed to provide:

Comfort for hens • Cleaner egg collection • Flexible installation • Easy assembly • Modular expansion • Efficient farm management

From small poultry farms to larger installations, the modular structure allows the system to be adapted to different chicken-coop layouts and management requirements.

We sincerely appreciate all customers who have purchased and continue to use ALPANGPANG products.

Thank you for choosing ALPANGPANG.

ALPANGPANG – A Better Nesting Environment for Hens and a More Convenient Egg Collection System for Farmers

products.name: TOUGH PITCH COPPER BUSBAR
products.description:
Copper Busbar is a high-performance metal conductor that plays a vital role in efficient and stable power transmission. It is mainly used in electric panels, switchboards, transformers, and power distribution systems, ensuring reliable delivery of high-current electricity.
Our company performs the entire process - melting, casting, extrusion, and drawing - in - house to produce busbars in a wide range of sizes and profiles.
We utilize electrolytic copper cathodes and high grade copper scrap as raw materials, achieving superior purity and excellent mechanical properties.
With low oxygen content, our busbars feature smooth surfaces, minimal porosity, and excellent, workability and plating performance

products.name: COPPER SHAPED BARS AND PROFILES
products.description:
Our copper shaped bars and profiles are engineered for high-performance electrical and industrial systems where precision, conductivity and reliability are critical.
We supply profiles made from copper grades with a conductivity of up to 99.9%. This gives our profiles outstanding electrical and thermal conductivity, making them ideal for high-current, high-energy and magnetic field applications. Through advanced extrusion and cold drawing processes, we achieve 
tight dimensional tolerances that exceed standard extrusion requirements. Cold drawing enhances mechanical strength, improves straightness and provides a smooth, clean surface finish, often eliminating the need for secondary machining. The result is superior dimensional consistency, high tensile strength and excellent machinability.
From simple flat and round sections to complex geometries with cavities, undercuts, and hollow conductors, we provide engineered solutions that optimize conductor design, reduce material waste, and improve thermal dissipation through increased surface area. Optimized surface area improves thermal management while maintaining electrical performance.
Profiles can be delivered as long lengths or precision cut-to-length components, enabling faster, hole- free assembly and significantly reducing cabinet installation time and labor costs. Copper’s inherent corrosion resistance, recyclability, and long service life make our profiles a sustainable and economically competitive solution. By minimizing machining, reducing assembly time, and improving dimensional accuracy, we help customers lower total production costs while enhancing system performance

products.name: SILVER AND TIN ELECTROPLATING
products.description:
Busbar plating enhances the electrical, mechanical, and thermal performance of copper conductors by protecting them from oxidation and corrosion. High-quality plating such as silver or tin ensure low contact resistance and reduce heat buildup. And they also guarantee long-term reliability under high current loads. 
This advanced surface treatment enables efficient, durable, and stable power distribution for data centers, EVs, and industrial systems. We operates its in-house automated plating facilities, ensuring full process control and consistent quality. 
Using high purity of Silver and Tin, we achieve 
a uniform, smooth, and refined surface finish that meets global standards. Our eco-friendly plating process, certified under ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001, reflects our commitment to quality, reliability, and environmental responsibility.

products.name: Plasma Deodorizer (Industrial Odor Control Equipment)
products.description:
Samdo Environment’s industrial and livestock odor reduction system is based on its core low-temperature plasma technology. The system generates highly reactive species such as ozone (O₃) and OH radicals through plasma discharge in the air, which react with and reduce major odor-causing substances including ammonia and hydrogen sulfide. Unlike systems that simply absorb or mask odors, this technology works by directly reacting with the substances responsible for unpleasant odors.
The system uses a dry process that does not require the continuous replacement of filters, deodorizing chemicals, or catalysts, and it does not generate wastewater, making maintenance relatively simple. It can be applied to a wide range of odor-generating sites, including livestock facilities, manure and composting facilities, sewage and wastewater treatment plants, food waste treatment facilities, and food and chemical factories. It is particularly suitable for sites that need to address odor-related community complaints and comply with increasingly stringent environmental regulations.
The system has been installed at various sites in Korea, including livestock farms, sewage treatment facilities, food factories, and resource recycling facilities. Its technology has also been validated through NET certification, patents, and performance testing by accredited institutions. We are seeking cooperation with Japanese trading companies that have established business networks in environmental equipment, livestock facilities, and industrial facilities.

Its key advantage is the **“Attach, Detach, Replace” modular platform**. While the bidet and toilet form one integrated unit, the upper bidet module can be removed or replaced. Users can retain the ceramic toilet base while changing the bidet or installing a dedicated console to convert it into a touchless toilet, providing flexibility to suit their needs and preferences.

VOHEN also delivers on the essential functions of a toilet. It combines effective bowl cleaning and powerful waste removal with a water-saving design. Automatic flushing reduces the need for manual operation after use, supporting a more convenient and hygienic bathroom experience.

Designed with durability and varying water supply conditions in mind, the VOHEN Smart Toilet aims to deliver dependable everyday performance. products.name: Senshave 360 Body + Intimate Razor (Razor)
products.description:
Product Name: SENSHAVE

SENSHAVE is the world's first truly unisex body grooming razor, engineered to safely shave any part of the body — from scalp to face, chest, and bikini line — with a single integrated device.

Key Differentiators

Active 360° Rotating Head: The only razor on the market whose head rotates a full 360° around the handle axis, enabling one continuous stroke across the back of the scalp, jawline, and bikini line — a world-exclusive mechanism.
5 Individually Reactive Nanotech Blades: Each blade flexes on its own axis to perfectly conform to skin contours, minimizing irritation and nicks. Competitor cartridges move all blades as one rigid block.
Close-Grip Handle: A radically shortened handle places the user's hand right next to the blade, delivering surgical control over high-risk areas such as scalp, jaw, and groin.
Internal Hair Chamber: Cut hair is trapped inside the head instead of scattered on the floor, sink, or drain — an industry-unique structural feature.
Ultralight Portability: 42g handle · 70mm short grip + 60mm head · Included hardcover case for effortless travel, gym, or hotel use anywhere in the world.

Technology & Quality Verification

Blade components manufactured by a proven Top 3 global blade manufacturer, reprocessed by SENSHAVE for proprietary compatibility (preventing use with other devices)
Design patents registered in the United States, European Union, Japan, and Korea
US FTO (Freedom-to-Operate) analysis by the Korean Invention Promotion Association confirmed low infringement risk across 766 reviewed patents
Aloe + Vitamin E lubrication strip · 5-blade nanotech cartridge · Up to 30 shaves per cartridge

Market Traction

Launched on US Kickstarter in December 2025 · Shipped to 12 countries within 3 months · Live on Amazon US · Sold out Day 2 at Paris K-Expo · Japan Makuake launch confirmed for October 2026.

Competitive Positioning

Gillette Body+Intimate (men only, passive 2D flex, wall-mounted), Manscaped Lawn Mower (men only, rotary trimmer), and Billie / Schick Intuition / Dollar Shave Club Women (women only, no rotation) are all locked into a single gender and a single mechanism. SENSHAVE is the world's first integrated grooming solution that transcends both gender and body part — one razor for every body.

products.name: ejen kimchi container
products.description:
E-jen Vacuum and Airtight Storage Container

 To store foods for a long time, we have to protect them from being perished and there are four factors playing a role in perishing such as 1) temperature, 2) moisture, 3) nutritive elements and 4) air. 
 If one of these factors is insufficient or doesn't exist, the putrefaction never happens or goes slowly. 
 One of the best way to store food is containers like canned goods or cans. 
 The canned goods are available to store foods for a long time for storing foods in vacuum state but they can be used just one time. 
 If there is a container providing vacuum like cans and is able to use several times, it will be an outstanding one.

 All the containers as we know are composed of bodies and lids. All of them have air layer with the same size of the contents (layer between lids and contents, HEAD SPACE) and the more we pull contents out of containers, the bigger head space and this makes molds or deteriorate the original taste of food by bad microbes in the air.

 E-jen, vacuum and airtight storage container, has vacuum plate (pressing plate) in the middle of the container and movable upward and downward. If you press the plate close to the food inside, the air in the container becomes minimized and blocks air flowing from the head space so it has very similar effect to cans. 
 There are many fermented food in Korea such as kimchi, soy bean sauce and pickle. To store these foods, people have used kimchi leaves to cover the upper part or wide and heavy stones for pickles not to float. 
 e-jen has silicon packing inserted along the edge of the vacuum plate. The pressing mechanism of the vacuum plate improves the insulation of the silicon packing and has the following features.

1) preserving perishable food in a container
2) compacting food
3) preserving perishable food in a vacuum state

The e-jen is preservative container with the same benefits of canned
Food in the utility sense of being a container, compactor and preserving
the contents in a vacuum state.

It can be positioned toward consumers who are particularly interested in maintaining gum health, including consumers undergoing implant treatment or those who are concerned about their gum condition.

5) Differentiated Product Concept for Overseas Markets

The combination of propolis and royal jelly extracts, liquid toothpaste formulation, pump-type packaging, and 220g capacity provides clear points of differentiation from conventional toothpaste products.
Its distinctive ingredients and convenient packaging offer opportunities for differentiated marketing across various overseas distribution channels and consumer segments.

products.name: P2J AI Physical Recovery System (Physical Condition Analysis and Personalized Recovery Guidance System)
products.description:
The P2J AI Physical Recovery System is an integrated hardware and software solution that assesses physical condition before and after exercise and provides personalized guidance on recovery equipment and its use. It helps community sports and fitness facilities implement a structured assess–analyze–recover–reassess workflow used in athlete recovery management.

The system combines an RGB camera, a thermal imaging sensor, a 3D depth sensor, and a pressure platform to collect heart-rate-related indicators, skin temperature distribution, posture and movement data, and body weight and load balance information. Its AI analysis platform compares measurements taken before exercise, after exercise, and following recovery, presenting individual condition changes in an easy-to-understand report.

Analysis results are linked to the recovery equipment registered at each facility. Staff can review and approve recommended equipment and usage guidance before applying a recovery program. Follow-up measurements help staff track changes in the user's condition. Compatibility with a facility's existing recovery equipment allows the service to be configured around its available resources and operating environment.

Designed for sports clubs, fitness centers, public sports facilities, athlete training facilities, and wellness centers, the system brings assessment and recovery guidance into one workflow. It supports consistent, staff-supervised recovery management while giving users a personalized recovery experience and a record of their condition over time.

products.name: SPM — Smart Physical Manager (AI Physical Performance and Sport Suitability Analysis Platform)
products.description:
SPM (Smart Physical Manager) is an AI-powered software platform that analyzes body measurements and physical performance data to identify individual physical strengths, assess sport suitability, and provide personalized exercise guidance. It translates assessment results into easy-to-understand reports, helping users explore suitable sports and enabling instructors to tailor their guidance to individual needs.

Using available data from school fitness assessments, including Korea’s Physical Activity Promotion System (PAPS), and fitness testing at sports facilities, SPM analyzes attributes such as strength, endurance, agility, and flexibility. It relates these attributes to the physical demands of different sports, providing information to support sport selection and suggesting exercise priorities that build on strengths or address areas for improvement. Repeated assessments allow users and instructors to review changes over time.

Students and parents receive practical information for choosing sports and engaging in exercise. Teachers and coaches gain a clearer basis for individual instruction and consultation. Schools, sports clubs, youth sports academies, athlete development organizations, and public sports facilities can use their existing assessment data to support personalized analysis and ongoing exercise management.

SPM’s sport suitability analysis provides exploratory guidance based on measured physical attributes and performance. It is intended to inform sport selection and development decisions alongside personal interests, technical skills, and experience.

products.name: P2J AI Child Growth & Fitness Solution (Child Fitness, Posture and Developmental Exercise Management System)
products.description:
The P2J AI Child Growth & Fitness Solution is an integrated solution that analyzes children’s body measurements, physical fitness, and posture data to guide individualized exercise and track changes through regular reassessment. It connects assessment, AI analysis, personalized exercise, and progress reporting into a coordinated process that supports healthy physical development.

The solution combines available information such as height and weight, fitness assessments covering strength, flexibility, and balance, and posture and movement data to identify individual strengths and areas for improvement. These insights help instructors plan activities for posture management, balance, coordination, and foundational fitness. Assessment items and exercise programs can be adapted to the target age group and the equipment available at each facility.

Reports help parents understand their child’s exercise needs and review changes in fitness and posture-related measurements over time. Instructors can compare initial and follow-up assessments, adjust exercise plans, and use recorded results during parent consultations. Facility operators can organize these assessment, exercise, and consultation services into structured recurring programs.

Designed for children’s sports facilities, developmental exercise centers, youth centers, and public sports facilities, the solution can combine analysis software, assessment equipment, and exercise programs to suit each operating environment. It supports healthy development through fitness, posture, and exercise-habit management; it does not predict or guarantee a specific increase in height.

It opens with a delicate and fresh forest aroma reminiscent of freshly harvested pine mushrooms, followed by a soft, savory taste and a deep, lingering finish. Combining rare Korean ingredients, long-term maturation, and Solraewon’s specialized production expertise, Pine Mushroom Liqueur presents the unique character of Korea’s natural environment in a premium traditional alcoholic beverage.

Volume: 300 mL / 720 mL
Country of Origin: Republic of Korea

products.name: Pure Gangwon

A small amount of wild pine mushroom extract is delicately added to soften the mouthfeel and reduce harsh alcoholic notes without creating a noticeable mushroom aroma. Low-temperature filtration further removes unwanted flavors and creates a clean, crisp finish. With its traditional 19.5% alcohol strength, Clear Gangwon combines the nostalgic character of classic Korean soju with the natural identity of Gangwon Province.

Alcohol Content: 19.5% ABV
Volume: 360 mL
Country of Origin: Republic of Korea

The product combines traditional brandy-making expertise with Solraewon’s understanding of the Korean premium spirits market.

Made from eau-de-vie distilled entirely from wine, MONROI X.O. delivers rich fruit and floral aromas, subtle sweet oak notes, and an elegant amber color. Its silky texture, balanced structure, and long aromatic finish provide a smooth and refined drinking experience without excessive heaviness or harshness. Presented in premium packaging, it is suitable for both personal enjoyment and gift-oriented retail channels.

Alcohol Content: 40% ABV
Volume: 700 mL

products.name: GOLDWIN
products.description:

Since its launch in 2016, GOLDWIN has built a stable sales record in the Korean market as an approachable everyday whisky.

Carefully blended malt and grain whiskies create a smooth and balanced flavor profile with gentle malt aromas, light fruit notes, toasted grain, and subtle oak. Its clean structure and soft body make it suitable for drinking neat, on the rocks, or in a highball. The distinctive gold-colored bottle provides strong visual appeal and reinforces GOLDWIN’s premium yet accessible brand identity.

Alcohol Content: 40% ABV
Volume: 500 mL / 700 mL

products.name: SEOLGUNG
products.description:
SEOLGUNG is a premium Korean traditional liquor created to commemorate the international winter festival held in PyeongChang and matured for 13 years. It was designed to express the pristine snow-covered landscapes and quiet winter forests of Gangwon Province through distinctive Korean natural ingredients.

Wild-cultivated ginseng, natural pine mushrooms, and native Korean honey are carefully blended to create a deep, refined aroma and a softly sweet flavor. Powerful ginseng and earthy forest notes appear together, while delicate honey sweetness adds balance and a smooth finish. SEOLGUNG was selected as an official toast beverage for the PyeongChang Winter Olympics and received the Grand Prize at the Korea Traditional Liquor Awards.

Alcohol Content: 18% / 30% ABV
Volume: 700 mL
Country of Origin: Republic of Korea

products.name: WIZPR RING V2 (Voice Recognition, Healthcare & Emotional Care Smart Ring)
products.description:
WIZPR RING V2 is an AI voice-input smart ring that replaces your keyboard. Simply bring the ring close to your mouth and speak—no buttons, no wake words (Close-to-Talk). Patented proximity voice detection (PVAD) captures only the voice within a 5 cm privacy bubble around your mouth, keeping the word error rate at just 3% even in 83 dBA noise. Whisper so quietly that no one nearby can hear, and it still transcribes accurately, while Sleep Mode automatically filters out surrounding conversations, TV audio, and accidental triggers in your pocket. The result is voice input that works in cafés, offices, and public transit—environments where conventional voice recognition fails.

As a universal input device for every OS and app—iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS—WIZPR RING V2 lets you ① type by voice up to 4× faster than a keyboard, ② chat with AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, including real-time translation, ③ control apps and IoT devices (Matter, SmartThings, HomeKit, Alexa, and more), and ④ delegate tasks to AI agents—all with a single phrase, even while your phone stays locked in your pocket. Speech recognition runs on-device in real time, with no cloud latency.

V2 introduces a new silicone unibody structure (structural patent filed) for improved water resistance and shock absorption, with swappable metal covers for personalized design. It also adds EDA and PPG biosensors, an accelerometer, and haptic feedback, enabling health and emotional-care features such as stress and mood monitoring.

The previous model, V1, has been mass-produced with CE, FCC, TELEC, and KC certifications and delivered to 1,350+ crowdfunding backers in 40 countries; V2 is scheduled for launch in 2027. Developer VTouch is a Natural UI specialist with 12 CES Innovation Awards over six consecutive years.

products.name: Rangemate Signature(Microwave cookware)
products.description:
RANGEMATE Signature is a patented microwave-only cookware that generates intense heat above 400°C (750°F), searing and grilling food to a sizzling, golden finish — no stovetop, oven, or open flame required.

The dish retains heat for up to 15 minutes after cooking, keeping your meal warm from the first bite to the last, so it never goes cold before you're done eating. The lid and handle stay cool to the touch, so you can handle it safely right out of the microwave.

Because it works with any microwave, RANGEMATE Signature goes wherever you do — the office, a dorm room, an RV, or a campsite. There's no need to disassemble parts for cleaning; the one-piece design wipes clean in seconds and is fully dishwasher-safe.

It comes in three interior-friendly colorways — Himalayan Greige, Riviera Cream, and Coastal Blue — combining everyday functionality with a design that looks great on any countertop.

RANGEMATE has raised over 500 million KRW (roughly $360,000+) across global crowdfunding platforms including Kickstarter, Wadiz, and Zeczec, was named the #1 kitchen cookware brand on Rakuten in 2024–2025, and has sold over 100,000 units in a single day on QVC in the United States.

What is Enzyme Vinegar?
Enzyme Vinegar is crafted from wild medicinal herbs and sea vegetables that are naturally rich in essential nutrients and bioactive compounds.
The production process consists of three carefully controlled fermentation stages:
Step 1 – Enzymatic FermentationNatural enzymatic fermentation transforms the raw ingredients into beneficial fermentation metabolites.
Step 2 – Acetic Acid FermentationSelected beneficial microorganisms convert the fermented extract into premium vinegar through a traditional acetic acid fermentation process.
Step 3 – Natural Aging & MaturationThe vinegar is slowly matured under both ambient and low-temperature conditions, allowing natural blending to create a rich, smooth, and pleasantly sweet-and-tangy flavor with a well-balanced aroma.

Directions for Use
1) Dilute 30–50 mL of Balsamic Enzyme Vinegar concentrate with water or tea according to your preferred taste before drinking. 
2) Also ideal for culinary use, including salad dressings, meat marinades and tenderizing, seasoning, deodorizing fish and seafood, and a variety of other cooking applications.

products.name: Kimchi seasoning powder
products.description: Our kimchi seasoning powder is an export-specialized complex seasoning powder developed to recreate kimchi, Korea's representative fermented food, in the easiest and most delicious way possible. This product is not simply powdered kimchi seasoning, but is designed to innovatively simplify the kimchi manufacturing process while preserving the deep flavor of traditional Korean kimchi. Traditional kimchi production requires significant time and know-how, ranging from salting the napa cabbage to preparing and blending various ingredients such as red chili powder, garlic, ginger, and salted seafood. Our product replaces these complex processes with a single powder, drastically reducing the hassle of ingredient preparation and measurement. In particular, our greatest differentiator is an innovative cooking method that allows you to complete kimchi without the salting process. Anyone can easily and quickly make kimchi simply by adding the kimchi seasoning powder to fresh napa cabbage or various vegetables and mixing it. This drastically shortens production time and ensures consistent quality regardless of cooking experience. This is a competitive advantage that significantly enhances productivity and work efficiency not only in households but also in mass production environments such as restaurants, catering markets, and food manufacturers. Our core competitive edge lies in our "technological prowess in designing flavor." By utilizing high-quality domestic raw materials and optimizing the balance of saltiness, umami, and spiciness through extensive research and development, we have realized the deep and clean flavor characteristic of traditional Korean kimchi. Our unique technological competitive edge lies in achieving an optimal balance that everyone finds delicious, rather than simply delivering an overly stimulating taste. Furthermore, based on our in-house R&D capabilities, we have established a customized recipe development system that allows for the rapid adjustment of saltiness, spiciness, and umami to suit the food cultures and consumer preferences of different countries. This development capability, which enables us to quickly incorporate buyer demands into our products, is a significant competitive advantage for us in overseas markets. Our powder formulation transcends the limitations of finished kimchi products and liquid kimchi sauces. It allows for storage at room temperature, significantly reducing the burden of refrigerated and frozen logistics. By minimizing gas and leakage issues during the fermentation process, it provides a competitive edge optimized for long-distance exports and global distribution. Additionally, by reducing volume and weight, we have increased logistics efficiency and effectively mitigated cost burdens incurred during overseas distribution. Our kimchi seasoning powder is more than just a simple condiment. We are a 'K-Food platform that enables the easiest and most stable implementation of kimchi-making technology anywhere in the world.' By combining taste perfection, manufacturing convenience, quality standardization, and global distribution competitiveness into a single product, we aim to set a new standard that allows overseas consumers and food companies to experience traditional Korean kimchi more easily and reliably.

products.name: Bulgogi seasoning powder
products.description: Bulgogi is a representative traditional Korean dish that enjoys high global recognition and is a representative K-Food menu item that consumers in various countries can enjoy without hesitation. Our bulgogi powder is an export-specialized complex seasoning powder developed to allow anyone to easily and quickly recreate the taste of traditional Korean bulgogi. It is designed to achieve the deep flavor of authentic bulgogi with just a single powder, eliminating the need to separately prepare or measure various seasonings such as soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and onions. In particular, unlike traditional bulgogi, there is no need to marinate the meat for a long time; simply place the meat in a pan, add the bulgogi powder, and stir-fry together, and the seasoning will naturally permeate the meat to complete the authentic taste. The biggest differentiating factor is that it is a "One-Step Cooking Solution" that allows anyone to cook easily and quickly, just like boiling ramen, without any complex pre-processing steps. This convenience not only drastically shortens cooking time and reduces labor costs but also ensures consistent taste and quality regardless of the cook's skill level. Therefore, high productivity and quality standardization can be achieved not only for general consumers but also in large-scale cooking environments, such as food service franchises, catering companies, and HMR and meal kit manufacturers. Furthermore, by applying a powder formulation, it allows for storage at room temperature compared to liquid sauces, and by minimizing volume and weight, it significantly improves international transportation and storage efficiency. Through this, we have secured reduced logistics costs, a long shelf life, and excellent storage stability, thereby possessing a competitive edge optimized for overseas exports. Our bulgogi powder is not merely a seasoning, but a "K-Food solution that brings the taste of Korea most easily and efficiently." By proposing an innovative bulgogi cooking method that is delicious without marinating, consistent without measuring, and as easy as cooking ramen for anyone, we set a new standard for the popularization of traditional Korean cuisine and the expansion into the global market.

products.name: Tteokbokki seasoning powder
products.description: Tteokbokki has become a global popular menu representing K-food, but with various Tteokbokki sauces and powder products on the market, it is difficult to secure differentiated competitiveness based on simple convenience alone. Our Tteokbokki powder is an export-specialized complex seasoning powder created based on the development philosophy of ‘taste is competitive.’ Without the need to separately prepare various seasonings such as red pepper paste, red pepper powder, sugar, garlic, etc., you can achieve the deep and balanced taste of authentic tteokbokki with just one powder, and anyone can easily and quickly complete specialty store-quality tteokbokki. In particular, by applying the one-step cooking method, which is completed by preparing only rice cake and water, then adding powder and boiling, consistent quality can be maintained without a complicated sauce making process. A simple cooking method, like cooking ramen, shortens cooking time and reduces labor costs, and enables high productivity and quality standardization in restaurants and HMR/meal kit manufacturers. The greatest competitiveness of our products is the perfection of taste. Through long-term research and development, we have realized the optimal balance of salt and sweetness, rich umami, and clean spiciness, creating a balanced taste that not only the authentic Tteokbokki flavor preferred by Koreans, but also overseas consumers can enjoy without burden. The biggest differentiator is that we developed our products with the goal of perfecting a taste that will keep you coming back for more once you taste it, rather than simply being a spicy and sweet product. In addition, based on our own research and development capabilities, we have the ability to develop customized recipes that can quickly adjust spiciness, sweetness, umami, and flavor to suit the food culture of each country and the needs of buyers. A flexible development system that can quickly reflect customer requirements in products provides a high competitive edge for overseas buyers and OEM/ODM partners. The powder formulation can be stored at room temperature and has small volume and weight, increasing international logistics efficiency and reducing transportation and storage costs compared to liquid sources. Through this, we are evaluated as a product optimized for entry into the global market by securing not only excellent product competitiveness but also distribution competitiveness. Our tteokbokki powder is not just a seasoning, but a ‘K-Food solution that delivers the taste of Korea in the most complete and simplest way.’​ No compromise on taste, simple cooking. We are confident that this is the great competitiveness of our tteokbokki powder products in the global market.

products.name: Doenjang Stew Seasoning Powder

This broad application potential allows the product to go beyond traditional Korean cuisine and serve as a versatile seasoning ingredient for consumers and foodservice businesses worldwide.

products.name: Japchae Seasoning Powder
products.description: Our Japchae Seasoning Powder is a powdered cooking seasoning developed to conveniently recreate the savory, umami-rich flavor and subtle sweetness of Japchae, one of Korea’s most representative traditional noodle dishes.Japchae is a traditional Korean dish made by stir-frying glass noodles with a variety of vegetables, mushrooms, and meat, and seasoning them with a soy sauce-based sauce. Since it is not highly spicy and features a familiar combination of savory and mildly sweet flavors, Japchae is relatively approachable for international consumers who are unfamiliar with Korean cuisine, making it an attractive K-Food menu for introducing Korean food culture to global consumers.However, Japchae is considered one of the more challenging Korean dishes to prepare, even for Korean consumers.
